name: Team Welch
subject: People over profits
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
Bills like the Inflation Reduction Act are the beginning of the end for corporations who choose profits over the people.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=930%2E61531%2EIk-D-x)
Team,
Did you know that, starting in his first term in Congress, Peter has consistently advocated to allow Medicare to negotiate lower prescription drug prices on behalf of its enrollees?
Now, it’s the law of the land.
Under the Inflation Reduction Act, which President Biden signed into law yesterday, Medicare will be allowed to negotiate drug prices for the very first time in history. This provision is expected to save Americans an **estimated $265 billion** over the next decade, and will provide much needed relief for families and seniors who have been struggling with sky-high costs at the pharmacy counter.
**Getting this done is a big deal, and a big win for Americans** —yet Mitch McConnell and national Republicans (including our opponent) are all against it. It’s a reminder of what’s at stake in this election: we can have a Senate that fights to help everyday Americans, or one that fights for the powerful interest groups. It’s essential we win this election for Peter and keep our progressive vision alive.
[**We can secure more progressive victories like the Inflation Reduction Act, but only if we keep the Democratic majority, and we need to elect Peter to the Senate to keep it blue. Please consider a donation of $5 or whatever you can to support this campaign and keep the Senate blue.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4184?t=3&akid=930%2E61531%2EIk-D-x)
_If you’ve saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically:_

All across the country, individuals and families alike are feeling the pinch of rising costs. The Inflation Reduction Act will take that issue on directly by lowering costs tied to health care and prescription drugs—all while reducing the federal deficit and building a fairer tax code that ensures the largest corporations pay their fair share._**Talk about much-needed relief!**_
This new landmark law is a signal to every large corporation that has repeatedly and recklessly put profits over people: We’re fighting back. But unfortunately, Peter and his Democratic colleagues passed the IRA without a single vote from Republicans. With the Senate split 50/50, the only chance we have to pass more legislation like this is electing more progressive Democrats. Thankfully, we’ve got one heck of a candidate in Peter Welch.
[**November will be here before we know it, and we’ll need All Hands On Deck for Peter to win this seat. Can you chip in $5 or anything you can right away to help ensure Peter wins this seat and adds another strong progressive voice in the Senate?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4184?t=7&akid=930%2E61531%2EIk-D-x)
Thanks so much!
Team Welch

Our state deserves so much better. Our state deserves Stacey Abrams.

That’s why we need to do everything we can to overcome Brian Kemp’s

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1992?refcode=sa_em_220914_B4_LGWFundraising_S1_T1_LGW_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=7458%2E1862389%2EcVgaFY ]DONATE

I found myself in Black Rock City the week before last almost in spite of myself, and returned to San Francisco last week just in time to celebrate the death of an international tyrant.
While educating Americans about the the continuing impacts of the imperial colonialism enabled by British monarchy occupied much of that week, I did want to circle back to share some reflections from my time in the desert while they remain fresh.
Below, I'll share some personal highlights from my most recent visit, as well as a few memories from years past, and some of my favorite art installations and mutant vehicles.
### **My week in the desert**
Black Rock City emerges periodically from the Black Rock Desert. For one week each year, it swells to become one of the largest cities in the State of Nevada. Within a period of days, it vanishes into the desert, leaving nothing but alkali dust in our wake.
I've been going to Black Rock City, the site of the annual Burning Man convergence, since 2003. The principles that unite our community have played an enormous role in my life, as have the people and networks who I've met both in the desert and at regional events from San Diego to Vermont.
As I ventured into the desert the week before last, I considered my intentions and articulated a hope to find some inspiration, as well as affirmation and connection. I've felt more isolated in the years since running for office than I ever did in the preceding 44 years, and experiencing the corruption of our system up close and personal left my sense of hope and possibility in tatters.
Thanks, each of my goals ultimately greeted me in abundance. My highlights this year included:
* Watching the 10 year-old son of some longtime friends play his DJ debut on an art car, a few hours before I followed him, hit all my buttons. He was not only the youngest DJ I've ever seen perform, but his music was legitimately funky! I look forward to bragging in the future about being part of his first public show (and hopefully scoring backstage passes when he's playing stadiums).
* Overcoming a series of challenges with DJ gear that night (from cables that went missing in the dark to components for which I needed to figure out substitutes on the fly) left me feeling like a cross between McGuyver and the Hulk. The show must--and did--go on!
* A 5-hour DJ set on the esplanade from midnight-5am on Wednesday morning led me to play nearly every track I brought with me to the desert. That, in turn, left me feeling musically satiated for the rest of the week, which impacted my experience dramatically. In years past, music has always been at the center of my experience, whereas I actually felt comfortable this year turning down a surprise invitation to play later in the week.
* The longest Wednesday of my life felt like it delightfully went on for at least a month before time seemed to shift, and then flew freakishly quickly over the rest of the week.
* Reconnecting with old friends from across the country, and finding a whole slew of new ones, is always my greatest joy! My favorite example from this year entailed running into a neighbor from San Francisco after playing capoeira at Center Camp, before heading to the 9:00 side to find a camp called Disco Monkeys that he said was hosting a workshop on making pasties. While asking around at a random camp near the designated coordinates to try locating that camp, I heard my name, looked up, and saw an old friend from my time in DC! In the years since I returned to the west coast, she moved to Brooklyn, where she joined another crew with whom I performed back in 2018, so it was great to see them all together. I rejoined them the following evening alongside my campmates, and spent hours together touring the playa on Thundergumbo, their camp art car!

While building the life I hope to establish, I've moved in fits and starts, taking steps backward in between those forward. That week in the desert felt like a giant leap forward, for more than a few reasons.
First, this was only my second time (out of nearly 10 trips to Burning Man over the years) that I did not camp with a theme camp. On the one hand, I counsel everyone who goes to join (or start!) a theme camp, since it enables contributions to the community beyond what we can make as individuals. That said, the chance to simply enjoy exploring the city, rather than building art or an experience for others, felt like a privilege. It also led me to random encounters that I'll not soon forget.
For instance, a series of three conversations on Thursday afternoon each started with strangers appreciating my work in politics, before leading to at least one (and maybe two) job offers to teach snowboarding at different resorts this winter.
Similarly, the chance to share a week of adventures with campmates, rather than a project, helped us forge a community of friends united through play, exploration, and mutual self-discovery rather than a focused collaboration. That enabled spontaneity that can be tougher to embrace when locked to a schedule. For instance, one of my favorite moments of the week entailed an unplanned visit to the Temple with my campmates, as we sat together and recalled stories about the departed relatives and friends who we each hold dear in our memories.
Finally, I treasured the opportunity to simply be myself, rather than a projection of others' political manias and fantasies. Having experienced a public character assassination in 2020 that reduced me to a racist charicature, each encounter with people unfamiliar with me felt like a new beginning. Each day offers every one of us that opportunity, but it took stepping out of San Francisco and my daily routine to remember how limitless the future remains.
### **A few invitations**
If you shared this pilgrimage, write back to share your highlights and/or favorite images! Hopefully we can cross paths another year.
If you haven't (yet), put it on your list--and feel free to write if you have any questions about how to plug in!
Finally, if you're in San Francisco this evening, join me at [Madrone Art Bar](https://substack.com/redirect/ee0c53cf-95b8-44a7-a98c-c78f148c79a5?r=1hvr60) at the corner of Divisadero & Fell! I'll be on the decks and the mic from 7:30 until 10ish before a second set featuring the band 6 Roses.
### **My favorite art from the desert**
I've collected a few images of my favorite art pieces, mutant vehicles, and figures from the playa, which I'm excited to share below. It's impossible to fairly describe the experience of Burning Man in words. And while each picture may be worth a thousand, even these photos can't convey the transformative whole beyond the sum of its fascinating, ephemeral parts...

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61284377:JwS3HHVvN:m:1:3334294963:535A779409486174E9D141992F3209AB:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of
hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61284377:JwS3HHVvN:m:1:3334294963:535A779409486174E9D141992F3209AB:r "I went on to play
soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61284377:JwS3HHVvN:m:1:3334294963:535A779409486174E9D141992F3209AB:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61284377:JwS3HHVvN:m:1:3334294963:535A779409486174E9D141992F3209AB:r "Scotty was
severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61284377:JwS3HHVvN:m:1:3334294963:535A779409486174E9D141992F3209AB:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61284377:JwS3HHVvN:m:1:3334294963:535A779409486174E9D141992F3209AB:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s
first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61284377:JwS3HHVvN:m:1:3334294963:535A779409486174E9D141992F3209AB:r "I will always
stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61284377:JwS3HHVvN:m:1:3334294963:535A779409486174E9D141992F3209AB:r "In 2007, we
welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61284377:JwS3HHVvN:m:1:3334294963:535A779409486174E9D141992F3209AB:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique
problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, Peter. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61284377:JwS3HHVvN:m:1:3334294963:535A779409486174E9D141992F3209AB:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61284377:JwS3HHVvN:m:1:3334294963:535A779409486174E9D141992F3209AB:r "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61284377:JwS3HHVvN:m:1:3334294963:535A779409486174E9D141992F3209AB:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61284378:JwS3HHVvN:m:1:3334294963:535A779409486174E9D141992F3209AB:r "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61284378:JwS3HHVvN:m:1:3334294963:535A779409486174E9D141992F3209AB:r "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61284378:JwS3HHVvN:m:1:3334294963:535A779409486174E9D141992F3209AB:r "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61284379:JwS3HHVvN:m:1:3334294963:535A779409486174E9D141992F3209AB:r "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61284380:JwS3HHVvN:m:1:3334294963:535A779409486174E9D141992F3209AB:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking
for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61284380:JwS3HHVvN:m:1:3334294963:535A779409486174E9D141992F3209AB:r "Step up now!")**_

---

---

name: American Update
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0796%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=mk6BV3%2fpVal%2b1nCWmO1xYQ&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33183%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=zoyuUYOsMLvmMckDVN3G3w&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33184%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=azkGgHut7I3ipwiDTIP9fQ&sysid=1)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c33184%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=azkGgHut7I3ipwiDTIP9fQ&sysid=1)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---
_625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314_

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---
| | **Now, the course is available in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or for use in a small group.** **** **You can receive the DVD box set as a thank-you for your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.**
Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.
---

Quantities of this special DVD box set are limited, so reserve your copy today. I’ve included a secure link for you to make your tax-deductible gift below:
[_**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/dvd-mathematics-and-logic-course**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z98vtfeu18u3f8pb04gl56o4g6p6hhfocsfjvmag_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9j66o30s1h2bs)

| | | Fellow patriot, Former President Trump is going on the offensive and appears to be launching a full-scale fight against the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI). I’m sure you already know the backstory: The FBI recently raided former President Trump’s home in what could be politically-motivated. This ordeal should paint a clear picture for us: The deep state is real, and we can’t afford to sit around playing defense while the FBI raids a former President’s home. **_We MUST go on the offensive._** [**And that’s exactly what I plan to do. Will you help me?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zk9u4l9ij2sm52s7i84udbt9bvt4ujs2ljia4t5g_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9j66o34sph2bs) _Our country is at risk of crumbling into a banana republic run by the most radical leftists in America and an invulnerable deep state. WE HAVE NO CHOICE BUT TO FIGHT BACK!_ When the news broke, our entire team sprung into action to respond. Within 48 hours, we filed more than 50 Freedom of Information Act requests to expose the Biden Administration and find out who knew what and when. But I assure you, the Department of Justice (DOJ) is not going to hand over information easily, and we may have to battle with the DOJ for months or even YEARS to uncover the truth fully. **We CANNOT sustain our efforts without you...** **[Will you chip in before it’s to help ensure our efforts can continue?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrcsgc92b4ado11f5l9uitau27njne5rl4dadk0g_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9j66o34sph2bs)**[ ](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5pskhodb6qejemsc69blvmtsbsru8ijjklv65n0_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9j66o34sph2bs) Let me back up. My name is Matt Whitaker... I was appointed acting United States Attorney General under former President Trump. In that role, I protected Law and Order both at home and abroad. Today I am Co-Chair of the Center for Law & Justice at the America First Policy Institute, where we strive to protect and preserve the rule of law in this great Nation. Together, we will fight back against the radical Left and end its unjust weaponization of the FBI. The team at America First Policy Institute is the best in the Nation, and we’re ready to make a HUGE difference for our country—ESPECIALLY when it comes to uncovering the truth regarding the FBI raid. [**I hope you’ll consider sending in a donation of $15, $25, or $50 today. ** ](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zs4dsfjcghevdalanht01g02jvhggaeajkvi2djo_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9j66o34sph2bs) Sincerely, Matt Whitaker Co-Chair, Center for Law & Justice America First Policy Institute P.S. We’ve seen it time and time again. Castro’s Cuba. Stalin's Russia. Nazi Germany. Mao’s China. Great nations fall to tyranny when governments weaponize law enforcement against patriots and political opponents. [**I’ll fight with every breath to make sure that America doesn’t have the same fate. Will you? ** ](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zm4sa5po2gme6uoe1qri7f72kab2et6060itr48g_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9j66o34sph2bs)

I'm a Christian, Trump-endorsed Navy SEAL running for Congress in the great state of Wisconsin.
[**I know my good friend Senator Ron Johnson reached out to you -- but you never answered his call for help on the eve of our biggest fundraising deadline to date... and we fell $9,937.19 short.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61288984:6-KSWHVHN:m:1:3317145305:258C3CFF614A12CA4E03104830C74356:r)

**[EXTENDED DEADLINE: 5X-MATCH FOR YOU >>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61288984:6-KSWHVHN:m:1:3317145305:258C3CFF614A12CA4E03104830C74356:r)**
Ron Johnson and I share some things in common:
We've never backed down from a fight with the far-Left, we're proud Conservatives, and we're both running in the #1 battleground state in the country.
**So why are we both reaching out to you?** _Because if we miss this extended fundraising deadline, our plans for victory will completely FALL APART._
[**We 're already behind but if we can close the gap before 5X-matching expires AT MIDNIGHT, I know we can turn things around. Peter, our extended deadline is about to hit so time is of the essence.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61288984:6-KSWHVHN:m:1:3317145305:258C3CFF614A12CA4E03104830C74356:r)

For liberty and America,
Retired Navy SEAL
Derrick Van Orden

Subject: Folks -
Sender: Ron Johnson (WI-R)**_
Folks -- this is Senator Ron Johnson.
I have a lot to tell you and there's not a lot of time. I'll make this quick:
* Wisconsin is the #1 battleground state in America for the House AND Senate
* My race is shaping up to be one of the most expensive races in history
* August 31st will be the single biggest fundraising deadline we've EVER faced

I'd be preaching to the choir if I told you how important the next election is. Our economy is in shambles... Democrats are trying to IMPEACH Justice Clarence Thomas... 2 million illegals crossed our border under Joe Biden's watch... Liberals just rammed through a huge Green-New-Deal-style climate bill... and now Biden wants to force American taxpayers like you to foot the bill for student loan debt.
**It 's 100% clear: this is a socialist takeover of America. And we are running out of time to stop them.**
I'm also teaming up with Republican Whip Steve Scalise -- FOR THE FIRST TIME EVER -- because we can't take back our country without taking back the House. [**That 's why I'm rushing to you in the final hours before our August 31 deadline to ask for your help.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61288984:6-KSWHVHN:m:1:3317145305:258C3CFF614A12CA4E03104830C74356:r)
I'm even told that for every $1 you're willing to contribute by midnight tonight will be matched with $5 thanks to a group of anonymous donors. _Please hurry -- everything rides on this deadline!_
**[Contribute $25 Now ($125 Impact)](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61288985:6-KSWHVHN:m:1:3317145305:258C3CFF614A12CA4E03104830C74356:r)**
**[Contribute $35 Now ($175 Impact)](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61288984:6-KSWHVHN:m:1:3317145305:258C3CFF614A12CA4E03104830C74356:r)**
**[Contribute $50 Now ($250 Impact)](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61288986:6-KSWHVHN:m:1:3317145305:258C3CFF614A12CA4E03104830C74356:r)**
**[Contribute $100 Now ($500 Impact)](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61288987:6-KSWHVHN:m:1:3317145305:258C3CFF614A12CA4E03104830C74356:r)**
The Democrats know that their ENTIRE socialist agenda depends on winning battleground states like Wisconsin.
That's why Liberal groups are unleashing $50,000,000+ to defeat me and other Republicans in my home state of Wisconsin. If we miss our August 31st, it will be impossible to hold the line here. [**In other words: WE NEED YOUR HELP RIGHT NOW!**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61288984:6-KSWHVHN:m:1:3317145305:258C3CFF614A12CA4E03104830C74356:r)
Time is short so I'll wrap this up. Our deadline is here. We're behind. But you can save us with a 500% matched contribution today.
Thank you,
Senator Ron Johnson (R-WI)
* * *
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61288988:6-KSWHVHN:m:1:3317145305:258C3CFF614A12CA4E03104830C74356:r)
Can you keep this between us? Pollsters, pundits, and the media are saying the unthinkable -- _Pelosi and the Democrats have a chance to defeat us. And with hundreds of millions of dollars in their war chest to spend attacking us -- they 're going ALL IN._
We'll say it straight: we're being outraised. And if we sit here and do nothing, Pelosi and the Democrats will buy this election from under us. [**If you 've been waiting to step up, now is the time. Everything President Trump worked so hard to build -- our Conservative Supreme Court Majority, a secure border, a booming economy, HIS ENTIRE LEGACY -- is on the line.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61288988:6-KSWHVHN:m:1:3317145305:258C3CFF614A12CA4E03104830C74356:r)
We still have time to turn things around, but we need to act fast. Whether we win or lose will come down to what you do in this moment.
\-- Steve Scalise, House Republican Whip

Friend --

With the midterms fast approaching, I want to call attention to some of the people who make our democracy work.

Poll workers play a crucial role in the administration of our elections -- helping voters cast their ballots, and making sure elections run smoothly. Without unbiased poll workers, our democracy doesn’t function.

Recently, however, poll workers have been the target of threats, intimidation, and harassment by people trying to undermine our elections and tilt the results in their favor. That’s why All On The Line has working hard to find and mobilize poll workers for the midterm elections -- because we can’t let the bullies win.

Your work with All On The Line helps safeguard the integrity of our elections by making sure that our local election officials are fair, impartial, and dedicated to successfully executing our elections and defending democracy.

| |
---
| | | __**[You may not know me, so let me share my story.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z3kvvqtlmd2fiu83l129s4tmvvmegobg9072pt58_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9gmcoj5cjh2bs "You may not know me, so let me share my story.")**__
My name's Tiffany Smiley. I'm a mom of three, veteran's wife, and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I'm running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring **real change** to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

>From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty _**earned**_ as an active duty service member, and I _**won**_.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to **advocate for _all_ veterans**, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

| | Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family.

https://www.facebook.com/TNVoterProject [https://www.facebook.com/TNVoterProject]
September 15, 2022
Dear friend,
We're still thinking of the families and folks throughout Memphis who were impacted by violence in the last few weeks. The TVP staff is saddened by these tragic events and for all affected, knowing the issue of violence isn't new to our community and that every loss is just as weighty as the last.
Though this has been a heavy time in our community, we have hope because of you. In the last few weeks, we've seen our community come together [https://www.cnn.com/2022/09/09/us/memphis-teacher-eliza-fletcher-killed-friday/index.html] to share mental health resources [https://www.fox13memphis.com/news/local/fox13-resource-guide-how-cope-with-mental-health-struggles-after-tragedy/SHQOIQ5BRZATTLR25P2UT6DPOM/] and raise money [https://www.gofundme.com/f/to-help-with-funeral-and-burial-expenses?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=p_cp%20share-sheet&fbclid=IwAR2BsioRQWxAPS5fuh7uvBVZRXLQ4UncAIOaIm2bV-cQ1HphDK-iQSiMAqg] for the families of victims. We've seen national attention and calls to action, including a powerful statement [https://www.sandyhookpromise.org/press-releases/sandy-hook-promise-statement-on-memphis-mass-shooting/] from Nicole Hockley, co-founder and CEO of Sandy Hook Promise and mother of Dylan, who was killed in the Sandy Hook Elementary School tragedy.
We agree with CEO Hockley that “our grief and fear must inspire us to take action to overcome the epidemic of gun violence. We must reject the notion that gun violence is inevitable because we know with absolute certainty that it is preventable."
While there are significant efforts happening to curb gun violence in Shelby County, the conservative leadership in our state is holding us all back from creating safer communities. What makes us safer is second chance programming, requiring permits to use guns, and more opportunities for youth. Conservative leadership has fought against all of these benefits to our community.
We need progressives in office like recent TVP endorsees Dr. Jason Martin for Tennessee Governor [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvpformartin] and Emily Fulmer for Collierville, TN Alderman [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvpforfulmer] who believe in common sense reforms and proactive efforts to ensure every family has access to opportunity before resorting to crime and violence.
Our community is hurting for leadership that will chip away at the status quo and work to ensure every family, every youth, every individual feels safe and supported. I hope you'll join TVP [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tvpaug17_1] in helping to make this happen.
In this together with you,
Tennessee Voter Project Staff

Friend,

This is the most disgusting thing I've seen on Twitter.

Middle schools in Tampa _(where we have a chapter and an educational youth programming site)_ have books in their libraries with **explicit** gay sexual content.

This book, Juno Dawson's _This Book is Gay_ , gives instructions to young boys on anal and oral sex, hand jobs, and how to use Grinder, the gay hook-up app. There is a section called "Boy-on-Boy Sex," which includes cartoon sketches of _a naked adult man in a book for 11- to 13-year-olds_.

[](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zatecgsokuskanltc4oi4ujql0q6ntre96binau8_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9gmaoj2cdh2bs)

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. I co-founded BLEXIT to create alternative educational opportunities for America's low-income and minority children.

Our educational youth programming teaches children about academics _without access to progressive ideologies like this_! It is part of our effort to fight against woke policies in schools.

We also promote school choice to give parents options about where to send their children for academics and learning.

That's why I've set a goal to raise $25,000 this week to fund our educational efforts.

Our values are**_Faith, Freedom, and_ FAMILY.** And books like this go against the family value...

We cannot trust public schools to teach American and family values.

It's why BLEXIT is a strong advocate for School Choice. We must create more alternative educational opportunities for our children, especially in minority communities.

Thankfully, one school board member, Lynn Gray, is on our side after part of this book was read at a meeting.

Gray stated that:

_**" Much damage has been done in terms of trauma to the audience -- both young and old after listening to the verbal descriptions."**_

But one school board member isn't enough to solve this problem.

I need your help to give parents an alternative to the woke sexuality schools are forcing on our children.

[_**Your urgent gift of $10, $25, $50, or more helps our long-term strategy of positively influencing the next generation >>>**_](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z0rjee6r0bmkmprq9mtqslms30b1c4lte1t5njto_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9gmaoj2cdh2bs)

Here is a short list of what the BLEXIT movement is doing to fight for these values:

* **Teaching REAL American History:** Students are learning "Critical Race Theory," which is nothing but propaganda that teaches them to hate America and accept a victimhood mentality.

BLEXIT is teaching students about real American history, the values that make our country so successful, and the wisdom of our Founding Fathers.

* **Skill Training:** Our public schools are failing to teach young minorities the basics. We teach young students the skills they need to get ahead in life. We are empowering young people with hope and opportunity.

* **Fighting for School Choice:** We must create opportunity and help minority communities escape the brainwashing centers they are FORCED to attend because of government unions. School Choice, homeschooling, and alternative education options will empower minorities to achieve the American Dream.

Young people want to be independent, take responsibility, and escape poverty. BLEXIT is giving them a chance.

| | | **
Fellow Patriot and Proud Conservative,**
_It 's hard to believe, but the most consequential Midterm Election in our country's history is just 2 months away._
When we look around our nation, it's hard to fathom how bad things have spiraled out of control since Joe Biden and the radical Left took control of power in Washington.
The historic economy from the Trump/Pence Administration has been wrecked with record-high inflation. Our southern border is wide open for millions of illegal immigrants to walk right in. And maybe worst of all, violent crime has exploded, threatening every American's safety.
**I believe one of the only ways we can end this madness is by electing Republicans to the Senate and taking back the majority.** I'm reaching out to YOU, Peter, because I know you have always stood for freedom and Conservative values. Can you step up and make a generous donation of $25?
[_**Please contribute $25 or more in the next 2 hours to help the Republican Party have the necessary resources to win and restore our majority in the Senate. >>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61289788:JNcBzHVNT:m:1:3331421248:F94DFE9DFE7C3CE30EE3FBEBD404C6F1:r)

I truly believe that with the support of every proud American like you, our Party can win and bring back our Republican Majority in the Senate. Are you up for it?
[_**Please chip in just $25 in the next 2 hours to restore our Republican Majority and bring sensible, America First leadership back to Washington.**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61289788:JNcBzHVNT:m:1:3331421248:F94DFE9DFE7C3CE30EE3FBEBD404C6F1:r)

body:

| | | | |

| |
---
| | | | | Peter, **Lauren Boebert wants us all to die.** No, you didn't read that wrong...In fact, there isn't much that hasn't been said about Lauren Boebert at this point. For a long time now, each time I think this bigoted, classless Congresswoman--who heckled President Joe Biden at the State of the Union while he was talking about his son's death--can't get any worse, she proves me naive yet again. [**Hopefully she will be beaten in her race. But, if not, she MUST remain in the minority. So will you please join us in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to the Democratic Congresional Campaign Committee (DCCC), so they can spend these funds in key House races and help us keep our majority?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T278ea7c9-13bb-4d33-86e8-ef52b0f8aa06/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _Whether it's off-roading in Utah, crashing her car and ditching her son and dog in the accident, as well as a sister-in-law in distress, but not before coaching her to lie about Boebert's having been there, to her husband recently crashing his car onto a neighbor's lawn and threatening to kill them, the Boebert family is an example of evetrything wrong with today's Republican Party and our poltiical system in general. This woman should be nowhere near a position of any power. _ Now Boebert has taken it even further. She took her grift to a right-wing authoritarian church where she preached (or, perhaps, babbled): **“We are in the last of the last days and the church has a role in ushering in the second coming of Jesus.”**

name: Linda Skaggs
subject: Betrayed by Biden for following President Trump's orders
body:
Dear friend,

Joe Biden betrayed my son.

Chad was a U.S. Marshal defending the Federal Courthouse in Portland, Oregon, during the violent summer riots of 2020.

But instead of rewarding Chad for bravely putting his life on the line to protect life and property, the Biden administration is allowing his life to be destroyed.

And now I'm afraid he'll lose everything...**[which is why I'm reaching out to you today to help my son.](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=bcac04010f8e4191b637c3205acb5e3f&_e=4qMFXhcbNUAzEMnp-AM8-U7-jKGQK53vFcdNHgbuclQa9QKewPMZ7S3LHDW5eSZswPO9OQKdLzF8Sn5Jv0Tz81wm7Fj9YsEaG8PzXnskLTCBe0UMVy_Na2og1i9P4TDufdu525q3uKnWc1woArrxHgnXt1Xfc41FxWe6xJEajlC-8DFW8k5JNWnkqYndTPVdRG9grsrQ38hPSWJcUj2o5xosf3UE_FJvuJVRMeTAe5XX3QW2WV7cKB5FLj-RxHwOG4LdRKsHN87PbHIV-bB9CFANNihdL0VLocc8qkmjFCS2KQyC8WBpcTwcYuj9NEuoPvFdYgtVTVKJCwCQ-SfUcZwWa_B53MwRa58aBJ1wlUQ%3D)**

That's my son, Chad Skaggs, his wife Roxana and my three beautiful grandkids.

[](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=bcac04010f8e4191b637c3205acb5e3f&_e=4qMFXhcbNUAzEMnp-AM8-U7-jKGQK53vFcdNHgbuclQa9QKewPMZ7S3LHDW5eSZswPO9OQKdLzF8Sn5Jv0Tz81wm7Fj9YsEaG8PzXnskLTCBe0UMVy_Na2og1i9P4TDufdu525q3uKnWc1woArrxHgnXt1Xfc41FxWe6xJEajlC-8DFW8k5JNWnkqYndTPVdTTGe1K21QPE3A0XOTjfhao3LiPu4giYxZ6ICfr7F1TH4Qllh8HjKJqIn8Lgf0JuvmcAPj6AIu1dZjMLI4ZfzEioBcgLdFHjfYzgfY5vPQzNeJ6E_56qlvFFWbB-5VsSVgg2p3JSqSLxysCpIZIm5BKebtFot_naRYmSEOLCsdOQ%3D)

At the height of the 2020 riots, President Trump sent Chad and his fellow Marshals to restore law and order in Portland--because the local and state authorities refused to stop the riots.

A violent left-wing mob blocked the Courthouse doors to trap Chad and his fellow Marshals inside.

**Then they set the building on fire.**

Thank God he escaped.

But outside--as the city burned around them--Chad and his fellow officers were pelted with rocks, frozen water bottles, and Molotov cocktail-style firebombs.

Eventually, the Marshals were able to disperse the mob restore law and order.

What happened next is shocking... and left my son and his family devastated.

**Leftist rioters brought a civil lawsuit against Chad.**

After escaping the burning Courthouse, Chad and his fellow Marshals tried to move the rioters away from the building.

One of the Marshals was forced to use his baton and pepper spray on the violent leftists who refused orders to disperse.

Video evidence shows minimal force was used against the mob. And remember, this was a group of radicals who tried to _**kill** _these federal officers--and then refused commands to back away.

All summer they were chanting slogans like _"all cops are bastards"_ and _"pigs must die."_

Still, the left-wing American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) jumped at the chance to sue Chad on behalf of the radical rioters.

President Trump was also named in the lawsuit, along with other officials and law enforcement officers.

With a lawsuit against a law enforcement officer, the government typically provides an attorney and legal resources for the officer.

**But Biden 's DOJ said it was _"not in the interest of the United States" _to defend Chad in court.**

**Joe Biden chose the rioters over my son.**

Chad was home recovering from hip surgery for an injury he sustained when they came to his house asking for his gun and his badge...

I know that Chad is being thrown to the wolves for purely political reasons.

And I know that Joe Biden is making a statement by turning his back on the law enforcement officers like Chad because they were sent into Portland by President Trump.

Let's be honest, the leftist base of Joe Biden's party hates the police.

They want people like Chad to suffer.

They know he can't afford to pay for a legal defense for himself.

They know he will be financially destroyed and his family will be destitute.

But they want to make an example out of him.

And so I'd resigned myself to thinking that there was nothing I could do and that the bad guys were going to win.

Until we got the phone call that changed everything.

It was Jason from LELDF saying they would help provide a free legal defense for Chad.

**[Believe me, your kind donation today of $35, $50, or $100 to LELDF to defend Chad will mean so much to our family.](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=bcac04010f8e4191b637c3205acb5e3f&_e=4qMFXhcbNUAzEMnp-AM8-U7-jKGQK53vFcdNHgbuclQa9QKewPMZ7S3LHDW5eSZswPO9OQKdLzF8Sn5Jv0Tz81wm7Fj9YsEaG8PzXnskLTCBe0UMVy_Na2og1i9P4TDufdu525q3uKnWc1woArrxHgnXt1Xfc41FxWe6xJEajlC-8DFW8k5JNWnkqYndTPVdUSgTZRKiXu7fwTrwCD3p3QLnX1adxf1qGHjbu2lrXuBnq5q1DOqAPD2owUel0x21gihqU06wU55SmChEKfplbsv0gNbelOea0wmelp1yCWACgvMY2fDG1jF_ZJ6oUi0wxIQABwH5UsUVHnvwp1x78ageIOxnI0YnRTPjlwjCZ64%3D)**

Friend, I can't emphasize enough that my son never asked for any of this!

After more than 14 years in the Army as a Green Beret, Chad has served with distinction for the past 11 years in the U.S. Marshal Service.

And this is the "thanks" he gets from the Commander-in-Chief: **betrayal and retaliation.**

**[LELDF is preparing to ramp up legal action in Chad's case, so I'm counting on your gift of $35 or more today to help fund his defense.](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=bcac04010f8e4191b637c3205acb5e3f&_e=4qMFXhcbNUAzEMnp-AM8-U7-jKGQK53vFcdNHgbuclQa9QKewPMZ7S3LHDW5eSZswPO9OQKdLzF8Sn5Jv0Tz81wm7Fj9YsEaG8PzXnskLTCBe0UMVy_Na2og1i9P4TDufdu525q3uKnWc1woArrxHgnXt1Xfc41FxWe6xJEajlC-8DFW8k5JNWnkqYndTPVdHkEgsGCaR7PHlhxhFpA_AWqabe0U5pxbZKjTC2v9fjvL5LhiHPv_kukFtFwDRnibfMp7dhsQkJb4osrbIaFbZYGZcad2usamiJM9bUdQr6UTcEPR5WK-IrvraPI8OqEijd92KX75RZA5rbzWJfBi1-SApSIJaoNqE6oS9aVu4ro%3D)**

Whether or not you can give, please keep Chad and our family in your prayers.

With deep appreciation,

Linda Skaggs

P.S. I know in my heart that most Americans are good people who support law enforcement and don't want to see my son Chad destroyed for simply doing his job. Please consider taking a stand for what's right today by helping my son by clicking this link: **[https://secure.anedot.com/leldf/cb2008faac55b0a983ae2](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=bcac04010f8e4191b637c3205acb5e3f&_e=4qMFXhcbNUAzEMnp-AM8-U7-jKGQK53vFcdNHgbuclQa9QKewPMZ7S3LHDW5eSZswPO9OQKdLzF8Sn5Jv0Tz81wm7Fj9YsEaG8PzXnskLTCBe0UMVy_Na2og1i9P4TDufdu525q3uKnWc1woArrxHgnXt1Xfc41FxWe6xJEajlC-8DFW8k5JNWnkqYndTPVdt7FRXzDEXnbvP2x0AGH2U-b8KRPrLL5ANT5AeuBzwzXYOqomxRiH0j2tFvG6jQP_YfipwjAHrLG8HpXdnAAJ94AWwW_heysNg-HGRm0qBWwGz3T_WO88UTOHNYMJ24ktfAT5H0l2cMTw7lvegCHjnp3Re48_UGbIIXUtt7i1MXk%3D)**

FROM MY SENATE DESK

Although we are no longer in session, important things are happening for the people of North Carolina. It's been a busy time of constituent services, meetings, and keeping an eye on court cases involving the state legislature.

Following are some highlights since this year's short session adjourned.

To get legislative news closer to the time it's happening, be sure to follow me on [Facebook](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001PCR_k8NsyzMWK-PSkvn2jLGZXaKPiACX9zcEPYykO-Kwq-IXaVxKtPWzSEJDCs-O3H1bYAmqveWgYRE4LY97W03w2nzT0ejWTKi7BLP7YKEdPzMHPQxsYtne4onue-bbIv-RmAJX22sjmtMRg2UHxtuS4LZ3bm4DQLNIHrbT3eg=&c=A9UZ2_ZuaBMjwgJLPnYTCJYsbDdgdTB7tWVva2T4MKB5NZZYQUkqaQ==&ch=gUgWDZd4WZ--17eAh1OO8pzU5TP37O4LXSTx766du1_IDzI-Dh-sfw==) or frequently visit my [website](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001PCR_k8NsyzMWK-PSkvn2jLGZXaKPiACX9zcEPYykO-Kwq-IXaVxKtOKaVpIVns9Ld4zJl_bGLOzhoM2k5UtY_sUBKxSGc9bE0rhNuSap5a6qXx_xYK8r67TsZrt2vWf-b49pIAONF9Q=&c=A9UZ2_ZuaBMjwgJLPnYTCJYsbDdgdTB7tWVva2T4MKB5NZZYQUkqaQ==&ch=gUgWDZd4WZ--17eAh1OO8pzU5TP37O4LXSTx766du1_IDzI-Dh-sfw==).

Chuck Edwards, Senator
NC District 48

---
| An Assault on NC's Democracy
---
| | |
---|---
|
NC's liberal Supreme Court Justices have just shown that your legitimate votes do not matter to them.

In North Carolina you need an ID to see an R-rated movie, board an airplane, open a bank account, donate blood, enroll your child in school, or apply for welfare, yet we continue to be 1 of only 15 states where you do not need an ID to engage in the bedrock of our democracy.

It's not for lack of trying. In 2018, the people of North Carolina voted in favor of a Voter ID constitutional amendment and since that amendment's first legal challenge in 2018, my colleagues and I have fought tooth and nail to defend the voting rights and will of the people. Accusations of racial discrimination, no legal standing, gerrymandered representation, and the like have all impeded our state's ability to implement the highly demanded Voter ID laws.

Most recently, North Carolina's liberal Supreme Court partook in blatant judicial activism when they decided to undermine the foundations of democracy by throwing out the votes of millions of North Carolinians who supported voter ID and a cap on the income tax rate in our state Constitution. Their justification? The legislature was elected under gerrymandered maps and therefore, the "illegitimate" legislators didn't have the power to add the amendments to the ballot.

By questioning the legitimacy of the legislators who voted to place the amendment on the ballot, the court is discrediting the value of every person in NC who voted to pass the amendment into law.

This power grab is yet another partisan attempt by the minority party to overrule the Republican legislature and the nation agrees with me. National news outlets have stepped in to speak out against the Justices' unconventional approach to undoing constitutional changes. Most notably, [The Washington Post](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001PCR_k8NsyzMWK-PSkvn2jLGZXaKPiACX9zcEPYykO-Kwq-IXaVxKtPUh-gC53IQP6oxVkJSn_rKkWaCLl2wnIYQxaEPYj6u_f20yPJPaRWyJdCqv6S_sQzKtzyhKnwDFflTSZPNMszJr3bAUuOEODksQIMFo4dZendB4wd-y5-R1c59k9Fr8Q9rqVoqZZFTuxlbiHoGqsBRHyvLjgOGHJoY_zzJ5mjxiKAdC2r6-eFmC1UKkpNh-Sg==&c=A9UZ2_ZuaBMjwgJLPnYTCJYsbDdgdTB7tWVva2T4MKB5NZZYQUkqaQ==&ch=gUgWDZd4WZ--17eAh1OO8pzU5TP37O4LXSTx766du1_IDzI-Dh-sfw==) criticized, "... partisan judges in a key swing state have announced that legislatures elected under the rules in place when voters were cast may be retroactively deemed to not have been real legislatures at all... The Democratic court's latest usurpation of the legislature is best understood as another partisan escalation that is straining the foundations of state government".

It's clear to me these Justices are more concerned with tearing down the conservative legislature to further the liberal agenda than they are with doing their job - preserving our state Constitution. Nonetheless, I will continue to fight for the people's will.
| |
---
| Preserving the Safety of NC Communities
---
| | |
---|---
|
I probably sound like a broken record when it comes to my urge for tighter immigration procedures in North Carolina; but every time I turn on the news and hear of another NC citizen harmed by a violent illegal immigrant with a criminal record, I am reminded of just how critical it is that law enforcement and the judicial system prioritize the safety of citizens over illegal immigrants.

This past Wednesday, I participated in a roundtable hosted by US Senator Tillis to discuss illegal immigration of violent criminals in North Carolina. The roundtable facilitated honest conversations among NC Sheriffs and legislators about the threat sanctuary cities pose on NC, how we can better protect our communities from violent crime, and how Biden's laissez-faire approach to the border crisis has impacted our state.

Sanctuary cities create a hub for criminals. They can retreat to these communities with certainty knowing their immigration status will not be questioned regardless of the crime they commit; and weak federal border policies only perpetuate the mass illegal immigration we see flooding to sanctuary cities, jeopardizing the safety of pre-existing community members. In my effort to crackdown on these issues, I worked diligently to get [SB 101](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001PCR_k8NsyzMWK-PSkvn2jLGZXaKPiACX9zcEPYykO-Kwq-IXaVxKtPUh-gC53IQPBWKAI_61lzTUTn3dM8S9poQPbebk4lsr_nqYaW8RCjJJdjJtDjSC2V8qa60GciiSGn_8iUW_yXwyZvrofmd_6R2JeVQbbAXcoE8r22fnZGQ=&c=A9UZ2_ZuaBMjwgJLPnYTCJYsbDdgdTB7tWVva2T4MKB5NZZYQUkqaQ==&ch=gUgWDZd4WZ--17eAh1OO8pzU5TP37O4LXSTx766du1_IDzI-Dh-sfw==) passed. It would have required that law enforcement cooperate with ICE, outlawing sanctuary cities once and for all in North Carolina but the bill was vetoed. In discussions of SB 101 at the roundtable, I found the most prominent point to be that both Governor Cooper and President Biden are simply catering to the wrong people. Rather than prioritizing the safety of citizens, they are fortifying protections for criminals.

The conversation was enlightening and solidified the importance of continuing to prioritize North Carolinians to supplement weak federal border policy. After cultivating a better understanding of what steps need to be taken to move forward, I am eager to continue showing up and defending the value of civilian safety.
| |
---
| NC Public Education: The Leandro Case
---
| | |
---|---
|
Late last year, the NC Court of Appeals overturned a Union County judge's efforts to legislative from the bench by placing a stop on his order to fulfill a multi-billion dollar education budget plan to avoid the closure of all state public schools. The decision highlighted Judge Lee's revolting attempt to degrade our Constitution and disregard a clear separation of powers between the judicial and legislative branches.

After the Court of Appeals' decision to overturn, the case was returned to the superior court and Judge Lee was replaced with Judge Robinson. Judge Robinson's ruling did not vary from the initial order, placing responsibility on the State to fund the remedial education plan that was crafted in California. The only difference is he did not order the legislature to force our hand.

In June of this year, the NC Supreme Court determined they would hear the case to determine whether a court has the power to require the State Comptroller transfer money in place of the legislature not funding the plan. They heard oral arguments last Wednesday and their decision will determine if the Leandro Plan gets implemented or not.

Ultimately this all comes down to who has the power to create police and enforce the disbursement of funds: the Courts or the Legislature? The legislature is the constitutional answer. The authority to create policy and "power of the purse" has always been reserved to the legislature; but with the liberal court's recent rulings and their urgency to hear the case before the General Election in November we must prepare to hear an adverse ruling that yet again challenges the foundation of our state's Constitution.

To provide you with more insight on North Carolina's investments in education, I'll note just how serious my colleagues and I take the responsibility of crafting a state budget. We have worked diligently since 2010 to rebuild NC's school funding, yet our commitment to public schools continue to be challenged by liberals who severely underfunded education when they were in control in 2010. Since the General Assembly's turn in leadership, NC Republicans have invested $3.8 billion more in K-12 education than our liberal predecessors. Funding has grown from $7.085 billion by Democrats in 2010 to $10.926 billion annually by Republicans in 2022.

Since 2011, the average teacher salary has grown by 20% and NC's average teacher salary has gone from 7th in the Southeast to 3rd. Additionally, our 61.6% state-level funding for K-12 public education is significantly higher than the national average of 47%.

The NC General Assembly has made responsible fiscal decisions while still supporting our public school system, which has led to North Carolina's economic security in today's volatile market - something that would not be possible with liberal budgeting.

No matter what decision is made by the NC Supreme Court, one thing will always remain true: the Legislature is the only entity equipped with the power and knowledge needed to make decisions regarding state expenditures.
| |
---
| Expanding Broadband Infrastructure in WNC
---
| | |
---|---
|
Broadband access has always been a contentious point for mountain families. The remote location of many western NC homes have left a huge digital divide amongst urban communities and mountainous rural households.

At the beginning of August, I announced a $4 million award to ZiTel, LLC to deploy high speed internet to approximately 1,572 households and businesses across Transylvania County. Although many of you were excited to see this funding to advance connectivity in Transylvania County, I noticed many of the "what about me?" messages from Henderson and Buncombe County residents.

That is why I am pleased to announce that the North Carolina Department of Information Technology's Division of Broadband and Equity has officially awarded funds from the Growing Rural Economies with Access to Technology (GREAT) Grant Program to both Buncombe and Henderson counties to expand broadband infrastructure to their more rural communities.

Frontier Communications of the Carolinas (Frontier) will receive $3.309 million to go towards expanding broadband services to approximately 964 households and businesses in Buncombe County and Cebridge Acquisition, LP (Optimum) will receive $4 million to deploy broadband services to approximately 1,495 households and businesses across Henderson County.

Technology plays a huge role in our everyday lives and in many ways it has become a necessity. I am thrilled that WNC will be receiving these funds to help ensure more community members have the broadband connectivity they need. If you or a family member you know lacks access to broadband then keep an eye out - you could be included in your county's expansion efforts!

For more information about the NCDIT Division of Broadband and Digital Equity, visit [https://www.ncbroadband.gov](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001PCR_k8NsyzMWK-PSkvn2jLGZXaKPiACX9zcEPYykO-Kwq-IXaVxKtPUh-gC53IQPnlK2IY5HEIdVIlpUq6l-1hv9iN6lOwi0p50qeEXfK5P87o5DwKoLhItk1_-qw8V2OD_VWhDGEp3bD2l2Zuy2DPwpU9zLQ5Djoqa5Ta9zBi1-JjCzNraAGRpzlb5bty4IotBSuWeVcWGndB6RNBL8n4CjU5nkBpkMfbeF-w45UTnz1SlQkkLPeTaWl8R0hvc1v9XjW1jhp4os26p-24VtHIOjqwv8TeT6RJ-zEfb171LdAG-AgmZdZU5Nn4PFNgAHMQWYtEa9o5FkC7X-LUhIuPKBMm29RZllXipF0iLHeC4Gd-DhPKRdG2a0dQhXcp6m4bAdEL5WgIDdM7Aw2rnmLTBYhT7dXYqcerpuaXaFQ4bqAX18yeDcEJJObyxUr96S-ceEavv-YgD34OKqg7rv-jFB7xHd56JccJn0Hp9EZUlMxv_6O2pclv0wAfySALI01PhNfQDwaTtx0S4J0-8CfIhg1teK2MiaiEYHuKv2vpMftWhymNz3dStXELrk4NRyyTDvNZA68FMwHyiQ5dTKsCvNZJbDfbpEB107GEdrqkUwikUegwBe0ujaiS0TeEXbR7Pq_wcvtpEhj-4Cyq_jwg==&c=A9UZ2_ZuaBMjwgJLPnYTCJYsbDdgdTB7tWVva2T4MKB5NZZYQUkqaQ==&ch=gUgWDZd4WZ--17eAh1OO8pzU5TP37O4LXSTx766du1_IDzI-Dh-sfw==).

clean_body: What You've Missed! | | | | | | | Having Trouble Viewing This Email? == | | | NC Supreme Court, Broadband Grants, & More | | | ---|--- | FROM MY SENATE DESK Although we are no longer in session, important things are happening for the people of North Carolina. It's been a busy time of constituent services, meetings, and keeping an eye on court cases involving the state legislature. Following are some highlights since this year's short session adjourned. To get legislative news closer to the time it's happening, be sure to follow me on == or frequently visit my ==. | | | ---|--- | Chuck Edwards, Senator NC District 48 | | | An Assault on NC's Democracy | | | ---|--- | NC's liberal Supreme Court Justices have just shown that your legitimate votes do not matter to them. In North Carolina you need an ID to see an R-rated movie, board an airplane, open a bank account, donate blood, enroll your child in school, or apply for welfare, yet we continue to be 1 of only 15 states where you do not need an ID to engage in the bedrock of our democracy. It's not for lack of trying. In 2018, the people of North Carolina voted in favor of a Voter ID constitutional amendment and since that amendment's first legal challenge in 2018, my colleagues and I have fought tooth and nail to defend the voting rights and will of the people. Accusations of racial discrimination, no legal standing, gerrymandered representation, and the like have all impeded our state's ability to implement the highly demanded Voter ID laws. Most recently, North Carolina's liberal Supreme Court partook in blatant judicial activism when they decided to undermine the foundations of democracy by throwing out the votes of millions of North Carolinians who supported voter ID and a cap on the income tax rate in our state Constitution. Their justification? The legislature was elected under gerrymandered maps and therefore, the "illegitimate" legislators didn't have the power to add the amendments to the ballot. By questioning the legitimacy of the legislators who voted to place the amendment on the ballot, the court is discrediting the value of every person in NC who voted to pass the amendment into law. This power grab is yet another partisan attempt by the minority party to overrule the Republican legislature and the nation agrees with me. National news outlets have stepped in to speak out against the Justices' unconventional approach to undoing constitutional changes. Most notably, == criticized, "... partisan judges in a key swing state have announced that legislatures elected under the rules in place when voters were cast may be retroactively deemed to not have been real legislatures at all... The Democratic court's latest usurpation of the legislature is best understood as another partisan escalation that is straining the foundations of state government". It's clear to me these Justices are more concerned with tearing down the conservative legislature to further the liberal agenda than they are with doing their job - preserving our state Constitution. Nonetheless, I will continue to fight for the people's will. | | | Preserving the Safety of NC Communities | | | ---|--- | I probably sound like a broken record when it comes to my urge for tighter immigration procedures in North Carolina; but every time I turn on the news and hear of another NC citizen harmed by a violent illegal immigrant with a criminal record, I am reminded of just how critical it is that law enforcement and the judicial system prioritize the safety of citizens over illegal immigrants. This past Wednesday, I participated in a roundtable hosted by US Senator Tillis to discuss illegal immigration of violent criminals in North Carolina. The roundtable facilitated honest conversations among NC Sheriffs and legislators about the threat sanctuary cities pose on NC, how we can better protect our communities from violent crime, and how Biden's laissez-faire approach to the border crisis has impacted our state. Sanctuary cities create a hub for criminals. They can retreat to these communities with certainty knowing their immigration status will not be questioned regardless of the crime they commit; and weak federal border policies only perpetuate the mass illegal immigration we see flooding to sanctuary cities, jeopardizing the safety of pre-existing community members. In my effort to crackdown on these issues, I worked diligently to get == passed. It would have required that law enforcement cooperate with ICE, outlawing sanctuary cities once and for all in North Carolina but the bill was vetoed. In discussions of SB 101 at the roundtable, I found the most prominent point to be that both Governor Cooper and President Biden are simply catering to the wrong people. Rather than prioritizing the safety of citizens, they are fortifying protections for criminals. The conversation was enlightening and solidified the importance of continuing to prioritize North Carolinians to supplement weak federal border policy. After cultivating a better understanding of what steps need to be taken to move forward, I am eager to continue showing up and defending the value of civilian safety. | | | NC Public Education: The Leandro Case | | | ---|--- | Late last year, the NC Court of Appeals overturned a Union County judge's efforts to legislative from the bench by placing a stop on his order to fulfill a multi-billion dollar education budget plan to avoid the closure of all state public schools. The decision highlighted Judge Lee's revolting attempt to degrade our Constitution and disregard a clear separation of powers between the judicial and legislative branches. After the Court of Appeals' decision to overturn, the case was returned to the superior court and Judge Lee was replaced with Judge Robinson. Judge Robinson's ruling did not vary from the initial order, placing responsibility on the State to fund the remedial education plan that was crafted in California. The only difference is he did not order the legislature to force our hand. In June of this year, the NC Supreme Court determined they would hear the case to determine whether a court has the power to require the State Comptroller transfer money in place of the legislature not funding the plan. They heard oral arguments last Wednesday and their decision will determine if the Leandro Plan gets implemented or not. Ultimately this all comes down to who has the power to create police and enforce the disbursement of funds: the Courts or the Legislature? The legislature is the constitutional answer. The authority to create policy and "power of the purse" has always been reserved to the legislature; but with the liberal court's recent rulings and their urgency to hear the case before the General Election in November we must prepare to hear an adverse ruling that yet again challenges the foundation of our state's Constitution. To provide you with more insight on North Carolina's investments in education, I'll note just how serious my colleagues and I take the responsibility of crafting a state budget. We have worked diligently since 2010 to rebuild NC's school funding, yet our commitment to public schools continue to be challenged by liberals who severely underfunded education when they were in control in 2010. Since the General Assembly's turn in leadership, NC Republicans have invested $3.8 billion more in K-12 education than our liberal predecessors. Funding has grown from $7.085 billion by Democrats in 2010 to $10.926 billion annually by Republicans in 2022. Since 2011, the average teacher salary has grown by 20% and NC's average teacher salary has gone from 7th in the Southeast to 3rd. Additionally, our 61.6% state-level funding for K-12 public education is significantly higher than the national average of 47%. The NC General Assembly has made responsible fiscal decisions while still supporting our public school system, which has led to North Carolina's economic security in today's volatile market - something that would not be possible with liberal budgeting. No matter what decision is made by the NC Supreme Court, one thing will always remain true: the Legislature is the only entity equipped with the power and knowledge needed to make decisions regarding state expenditures. | | | Expanding Broadband Infrastructure in WNC | | | ---|--- | Broadband access has always been a contentious point for mountain families. The remote location of many western NC homes have left a huge digital divide amongst urban communities and mountainous rural households. At the beginning of August, I announced a $4 million award to ZiTel, LLC to deploy high speed internet to approximately 1,572 households and businesses across Transylvania County. Although many of you were excited to see this funding to advance connectivity in Transylvania County, I noticed many of the "what about me?" messages from Henderson and Buncombe County residents. That is why I am pleased to announce that the North Carolina Department of Information Technology's Division of Broadband and Equity has officially awarded funds from the Growing Rural Economies with Access to Technology (GREAT) Grant Program to both Buncombe and Henderson counties to expand broadband infrastructure to their more rural communities. Frontier Communications of the Carolinas (Frontier) will receive $3.309 million to go towards expanding broadband services to approximately 964 households and businesses in Buncombe County and Cebridge Acquisition, LP (Optimum) will receive $4 million to deploy broadband services to approximately 1,495 households and businesses across Henderson County. Technology plays a huge role in our everyday lives and in many ways it has become a necessity. I am thrilled that WNC will be receiving these funds to help ensure more community members have the broadband connectivity they need. If you or a family member you know lacks access to broadband then keep an eye out - you could be included in your county's expansion efforts! ---
| Policies like giving driver's licenses to illegal immigrants, a policy openly embraced by my opponent Maura Healey, undermine the public safety, public health, and election integrity of our state.
---
|
---
| Meanwhile, we have a crisis at America's southern border. All at once, it is a humanitarian crisis, a public safety crisis, a public health crisis, and a national security crisis. Sadly, the Biden administration has proven itself unwilling and unable to address it.
As a result, states across our nation are dealing with an influx of illegal immigrants that they are not equipped to handle and should not be forced to accommodate. When that happens, governors naturally seek alternatives to protect the people of their state.
---
---
|
---
---
| Last night, this problem manifested itself with the relocation of several dozen illegal immigrants from Florida to Martha's Vineyard.

I applaud the people of Martha's Vineyard who instantly sprang into action to address this situation as it unfolded. I also lament the fact that a motivating factor in Florida's decision to relocate immigrants here is that Massachusetts has become a 'sanctuary state,' making it a natural destination.
Instead of making it easier for illegal immigrants to come here, we need policies that will make it better for legal immigrants to choose Massachusetts as a destination to pursue a better life for themselves and their families. As Governor, I will fight for such policies here, while remaining tough on the issue of illegal immigration and pushing for better federal management of this issue.
---

All at once, it is a humanitarian crisis, a public safety crisis, a public health crisis, and a national security crisis. Sadly, the Biden administration has proven itself unwilling and unable to address it. As a result, states across our nation are dealing with an influx of illegal immigrants that they are not equipped to handle and should not be forced to accommodate. When that happens, governors naturally seek alternatives to protect the people of their state. | | Last night, this problem manifested itself with the relocation of several dozen illegal immigrants from Florida to Martha's Vineyard. | | Folks, I hope you’ll join me in celebrating Hispanic Heritage Month here in NV-03 and across the country. The Hispanic community is part of the backbone that makes Nevada as great as it is today. Their culture, excellence, and contributions in local communities across our state are invaluable and seen everyday. Nevada would not be what it is today without the Hispanic community. In the past two decades alone, the Hispanic population has grown to represent more than a quarter of Nevada’s total population. We’re better off because of our growth in Hispanic representation across the Silver State. If you haven’t already, take this month to research, get involved with, and support Hispanic communities and culture in your community. Our society benefits from our desire to learn about and embrace our cultural diversity. In celebration, Susie Lee

| | | Today marks the beginning of Hispanic Heritage Month!
---
| [Celebrate with us](https://click.everyaction.com/k/50745919/367053007/1094330837?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NGRjMTc3Ni0wZjM1LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2rSQc-jL3oENM6NDD4ZhPmlee15_ukgEaIedWGZX_P4=&emci=0bb82f69-0435-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=64dc1776-0f35-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=6787172) |
