Friend,
**With the start of Hispanic Heritage Month, this is the time where we celebrate the histories, cultures, and contributions of American citizens whose ancestors hail from Mexico, Spain, the Caribbean, and Central and South America. This month is also an important reminder of how much strength we draw as a nation from our immigrant roots and our values as a nation of immigrants.**
Here at NextGen America, we celebrate our diversity and civic engagement. We take pride in the work we put in all while making great strides to support and uplift the voices in the Latino community. Over the next month, we will be highlighting the diversity of our staff, volunteers, and our community.
[Take a second to check out how you can celebrate Hispanic Heritage Month!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/50745920/367053008/-471753104?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NGRjMTc3Ni0wZjM1LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2rSQc-jL3oENM6NDD4ZhPmlee15_ukgEaIedWGZX_P4=&emci=0bb82f69-0435-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=64dc1776-0f35-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=6787172)
Along with celebrating the diversity and cultures of the Latino community, we are also recognizing the issues the Latino community still faces today across the nation. U.S. Latinos are underpaid, under-resourced, and overlooked. It is time for us to take power and drive the conversation towards the issues that we care about.
Every 30 seconds, a young Latino in the U.S. becomes eligible to vote. With a record 32 million voters, Latinos are now the largest voting bloc in the U.S. after white Americans. **The numbers don’t lie — Latino voters have the political power to enact real change in our country.**
[Join us by taking action in support of Hispanic Heritage Month!](https://click.everyaction.com/k/50745922/367053009/-2037837045?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NGRjMTc3Ni0wZjM1LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2rSQc-jL3oENM6NDD4ZhPmlee15_ukgEaIedWGZX_P4=&emci=0bb82f69-0435-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&emdi=64dc1776-0f35-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&ceid=6787172)
As the Latino population in the United States becomes more politically active, it is important for politicians and policymakers to understand and reflect these values. From climate change to a just economy, Latinos can lead the way by taking our power to the next level — the polls.
With the growth of the Latino community comes the power to impact the decisions being made at all levels of government. When we vote, organize, and fight for the things we believe in, with our numbers, we can effect real change.
**P.S.** \- By signing up for our texts, you’ll be updated on election information, local events, and ways to take action in your community. Text **HHM** to **25998***.
Solidarity,
Natalie Monteiro
Digital Associate
NextGen America

clean_body: | | | Today marks the beginning of Hispanic Heritage Month! | | | Friend, With the start of Hispanic Heritage Month, this is the time where we celebrate the histories, cultures, and contributions of American citizens whose ancestors hail from Mexico, Spain, the Caribbean, and Central and South America. This month is also an important reminder of how much strength we draw as a nation from our immigrant roots and our values as a nation of immigrants. Here at NextGen America, we celebrate our diversity and civic engagement. We take pride in the work we put in all while making great strides to support and uplift the voices in the Latino community. Over the next month, we will be highlighting the diversity of our staff, volunteers, and our community. Along with celebrating the diversity and cultures of the Latino community, we are also recognizing the issues the Latino community still faces today across the nation. U.S. Latinos are underpaid, under-resourced, and overlooked. It is time for us to take power and drive the conversation towards the issues that we care about. Every 30 seconds, a young Latino in the U.S. becomes eligible to vote. With a record 32 million voters, Latinos are now the largest voting bloc in the U.S. after white Americans. The numbers don’t lie — Latino voters have the political power to enact real change in our country. As the Latino population in the United States becomes more politically active, it is important for politicians and policymakers to understand and reflect these values. From climate change to a just economy, Latinos can lead the way by taking our power to the next level — the polls. With the growth of the Latino community comes the power to impact the decisions being made at all levels of government. When we vote, organize, and fight for the things we believe in, with our numbers, we can effect real change. Today marks the first day of Hispanic Heritage Month, a time when we recognize and celebrate the incredible contributions that Hispanic Americans have imparted to our country.

In Pinellas County, I am extremely proud of our bright, strong Hispanic community. From the volunteers on my campaign to the workers in our hospitals, schools, businesses, and neighborhood shops, we are surrounded by the amazing history, culture, and achievements of Hispanic individuals and families.

Alongside our celebrations, this Hispanic Heritage Month is also a reminder of the resources that we must continue to fight for. Hispanic communities have been left behind on critical rights, including workers' compensation and benefits, healthcare, and education.

I look forward to the amazing events that we have planned around St. Pete and Pinellas County, and I also look forward to fighting alongside you to forge a better future for every American.

Fellow Patriot,
Recently members of the church I attend waged a public awareness campaign about an inappropriate book that was being used to indoctrinate our children in our public schools.

Emails were sent to the school and shared publicly online. Unaware parents became savvy to the fact that their children were being preyed upon by those they had entrusted to their care for nurturing academic skills. The push back resulted in the book being removed from the school.

Our children are worth fighting for and we can be the difference in this heinous ploy targeting their innocence for perversion by standing up for them!

The Charlotte International Arts Festival (CIAF) is this weekend and they are offering a Drag Queen Story Hour
“for fun lovers of all ages”.
https://secure.anedot.com/b5c81bee-6e5f-4118-91cb-3dab5c3f0037/rejecting-drag-queen-story-hour?utm_source=Tyler+Lee+for+Congress&utm_campaign=4fb34edfb4-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_07_19_10_56_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_ac8d25e432-4fb34edfb4-617881201

Federal agencies that are utilized to intimidate us from speaking up against a Radical Left agenda should not deter us from voicing our rejection of these abhorrent attempts to ensnare our children! Enough is enough!

I have emailed Charlotte City Council Members and have provided their emails below for you to do the same. Please let them know that we won’t stand for this!

I'm a Christian, Trump-endorsed Navy SEAL running for Congress in the great state of Wisconsin.
[******I know my good friend Senator Ron Johnson reached out to you -- but you never answered his call for help on the eve of our biggest fundraising deadline to date... and we fell $9,937.19 short.**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zd65b6qfnavvfira4iuch3acgmsrm6leq9jde9hg_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9im1pb4cth2bs)

Ron Johnson and I share some things in common:
We've never backed down from a fight with the far-Left, we're proud Conservatives, and we're both running in the #1 battleground state in the country.
**So why are we both reaching out to you?** _Because if we miss this extended fundraising deadline, our plans for victory will completely FALL APART._
****[******We 're already behind but if we can close the gap before 5X-matching expires AT MIDNIGHT, I know we can turn things around. Friend, our extended deadline is about to hit so time is of the essence.**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zl04tdqdo751dh4kgs87h2mukcu5rugfi48tfnc8_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9im1pb4cth2bs)

Retired Navy SEAL
Derrick Van Orden

I have a lot to tell you and there's not a lot of time. I'll make this quick:
* Wisconsin is the #1 battleground state in America for the House AND Senate
* My race is shaping up to be one of the most expensive races in history
* August 31st will be the single biggest fundraising deadline we've EVER faced

I'd be preaching to the choir if I told you how important the next election is. Our economy is in shambles... Democrats are trying to IMPEACH Justice Clarence Thomas... 2 million illegals crossed our border under Joe Biden's watch... Liberals just rammed through a huge Green-New-Deal-style climate bill... and now Biden wants to force American taxpayers like you to foot the bill for student loan debt.
**It 's 100% clear: this is a socialist takeover of America. And we are running out of time to stop them.**
I'm also teaming up with Republican Whip Steve Scalise -- FOR THE FIRST TIME EVER -- because we can't take back our country without taking back the House. [**That 's why I'm rushing to you in the final hours before our August 31 deadline to ask for your help.**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zmkr3mn54ha8hb9aldh05b3avnlq4eq723b5jn2o_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9im1pb4cth2bs)

**[Contribute $25 Now ($125 Impact)](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z0r68o0ao8ma2vunvoc55v18c5kq4pf6th823id8_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9im1pb4cth2bs)**
**[Contribute $50 Now ($250 Impact)](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zujajfbv60tc8qvlf6i57fbepapcr6dbtqmjsrs8_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9im1pb4cth2bs)**
**[Contribute $100 Now ($500 Impact)](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zi55f2v90tuc9uv4ps6157p104m380c72b7p2rlo_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9im1pb4cth2bs)**
The Democrats know that their ENTIRE socialist agenda depends on winning battleground states like Wisconsin.
That's why Liberal groups are unleashing $50,000,000+ to defeat me and other Republicans in my home state of Wisconsin. If we miss our August 31st, it will be impossible to hold the line here. [**In other words: WE NEED YOUR HELP RIGHT NOW!**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z677dfkkkbr9ui8dk5kg5fvfjfpe42fi0b0gqta0_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9im1pb4cth2bs)
Time is short so I'll wrap this up. Our deadline is here. We're behind. But you can save us with a 500% matched contribution today.
Thank you,
Senator Ron Johnson (R-WI)

Can you keep this between us? Pollsters, pundits, and the media are saying the unthinkable -- _Pelosi and the Democrats have a chance to defeat us. And with hundreds of millions of dollars in their war chest to spend attacking us -- they 're going ALL IN._

**Friend – I just got off the phone with my team, and I have some bad news to share: We're currently $21,394 short of our critical mid-month goal.**
This news couldn't come at a worst time. The GOP is pouring over $35 MILLION into Georgia to defeat me – and they're _outspending_ us in this critical final stretch. Now, recent polls are showing me 2 points down from my Trump-backed opponent, Herschel Walker.
**If we lose here in Georgia, Democrats will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell.**** ****It's plain and simple. And this surge in GOP spending could further tip the scales in Walker's favor – unless we fight back immediately.**

| | | _**I 'm not asking for money, just your signature.**_

_**[You may not know me, friend, so let me share my story.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61286911:JE-DSHV9N:m:1:3345639852:6AC542C6C9690C5C5CC8866931EE08E7:r "You may not know me, friend, so let
me share my story.")**_

My name's Tiffany Smiley. I'm a mom of 3, veteran's wife, and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I'm running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring _**real change**_ to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty earned as an active duty service member, and I **won**.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to advocate for all veterans, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

_**[Now, I need your help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61286911:JE-DSHV9N:m:1:3345639852:6AC542C6C9690C5C5CC8866931EE08E7:r "Now, I need your help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by
the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.")**_

Murray has been in office for 3 decades and has done _**nothing**_ to stop the rising crime, homelessness, and drug addiction crisis tearing my beloved home state apart.

I'm running for U.S. Senate because Americans deserve better than the _**failed**_ leadership they've been stuck with for _**years**_.

It's time for a change in D.C., and I'm the right person for the job.

The latest polls in Washington show that my opponent and I will be neck and neck, and I'm getting nervous. We're finally closing in on Murray, but I need your support to cross the finish line.

Can you endorse my campaign to help me take the lead to save Washington?

But what is truly unfair is how innocent Illinoisans will be put in harm’s way as dangerous criminals will now be set free in our neighborhoods because of this bill. The elimination of cash bail means that the criteria for arresting a suspected criminal will be more difficult to meet, forcing police officers to arrest less suspects out of fear of punishment, essentially handcuffing them from performing the duties of their career. subject: Humbly asking you to read this all the way through
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
|
---
| | | Peter,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been reaching out more recently, but that's only because we have less than sixty days until the Election and we're falling behind our Mid-Month Goal.

**I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I 'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.**

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61295732:63P45HVN9:m:1:3317145305:8515FEDEBB9E03BA23E9F7ED5FB9C3C6:r "2")
---
_My parents on their Wedding Day._
This is a photo of my parents on their wedding day. Thankfully, they came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream they came to realize.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61295732:63P45HVN9:m:1:3317145305:8515FEDEBB9E03BA23E9F7ED5FB9C3C6:r "1")
---
_My sister, Veronica, our mother, and me at graduation._
Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette in college and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61295732:63P45HVN9:m:1:3317145305:8515FEDEBB9E03BA23E9F7ED5FB9C3C6:r "3")
---
_My wife, Jeanette, my daughter, Amanda, and me, circa 2000._
All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61295732:63P45HVN9:m:1:3317145305:8515FEDEBB9E03BA23E9F7ED5FB9C3C6:r " alias=")
---
_Campaigning for president in 2015 with my beautiful family._
After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61295732:63P45HVN9:m:1:3317145305:8515FEDEBB9E03BA23E9F7ED5FB9C3C6:r "5")
---
_On the campaign trail in August 2022. _
**This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.**
I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real.**If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.
****[I hope you'll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61295732:63P45HVN9:m:1:3317145305:8515FEDEBB9E03BA23E9F7ED5FB9C3C6:r "I hope you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:")**
---
| | | [RESTORE THE AMERICAN DREAM](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61295732:63P45HVN9:m:1:3317145305:8515FEDEBB9E03BA23E9F7ED5FB9C3C6:r "RESTORE THE AMERICAN DREAM")
---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio
---

After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream they came to realize. | "1" My sister, Veronica, our mother, and me at graduation. Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated. I met my wife Jeanette in college and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...). | "3" My wife, Jeanette, my daughter, Amanda, and me, circa 2000. All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted. I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did. My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me. | " alias=" Campaigning for president in 2015 with my beautiful family. After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support. I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream. | "5" On the campaign trail in August 2022. This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream. I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from. Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real.If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream. I'm not going to lie, this scares me. We are less than 100 days until the election and my far-Left opponent is raising millions of dollars and gaining ground in the polls. I'm sick and tired of people saying that Florida isn't going to be a tight race, because clearly, it is. This poll is the latest proof that the Democrats' plan is working. clean_body: | | | | | == | | | Greater Georgia Newsletter September 15, 2022 Can you believe we are only 54 DAYS out from the Tuesday, November 8th General Election in Georgia? With Labor Day past us, we are kicking it into overdrive and will be out in the field every day leading up until the election. We can't win in November without you-- so please, consider volunteering to help us on the ground by signing up ==, or donating to support our efforts ==. | | | LATEST EVENTS HISPANIC OUTREACH EFFORTS This summer, Greater Georgia launched its Hispanic Outreach Initiative and since then, we have had dozens of registration events in Hispanic communities. We are reaching voters where inflation is hitting hardest-- the supermarket! August 3, 17, 19, 23, 31, 2022 | | | | | REGISTRATION RODEO Greater Georgia had its first annual Registration Rodeo last Labor Day weekend. name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you.
[View this message in your browser](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zc3nqbgj1k6b2fppcfbokg1srbem6brjv9cae87g_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9hm2o74cph238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuij791lmkp79dhk6eojacpl6er7actl6tr779hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onmedgjep3hc6r39ob6eepm0o9l6io7adr265q64sjm62qb0srks6on8t9heaq6eduie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6cc9imdgmfcjkcor69cr66uobapbi4no)

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z1lf1ikos0bvagbfmfgikbc4jv0s60e5numigmvo_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9hm2o74cph2bs "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zso8ieskfcgut9n5u4lqt6beju3sqi21bs49ups0_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9hm2o74cph2bs "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zsequp6nhg8dsv45g7amr54ksg5tr4pvklimm54g_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9hm2o74cph2bs "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zm5bsj6daabu153676s39ogllbcuktbdvqpq6a9o_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9hm2o74cph2bs "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z775gj9ib1gt54f6b43d99feligvu34efnkd7hp0_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9hm2o74cph2bs "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zfl8655j2iqngm6j2cjjphirotks0k9ff300ubg8_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9hm2o74cph2bs "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zp0fsis2npolq74dsliafi9b6k64n8t9r7u1e5mo_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9hm2o74cph2bs "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zha75ulnq36j7cgt4un25bqfgdc4l6jvua6fo2ag_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9hm2o74cph2bs "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---

| | | _**I’m not asking for money, just your signature.**_

_**[You may not know me, friend, so let me share my story.](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85114%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=wBZ%2bG%2b7bTmFONpWFR5xLug&sysid=1 "You may not know me, friend, so let me share
my story.")**_

My name’s Tiffany Smiley. I’m a mom of 3, veteran’s wife, and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I’m running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring _**real change**_ to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty earned as an active duty service member, and I **won**.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to advocate for all veterans, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

_**[Now, I need your help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85125%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=iwt5vr8xBWJ%2fU2vZSAzBCg&sysid=1 "Now, I need your help to send me to D.C. to
advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible
policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.")**_

Murray has been in office for 3 decades and has done _**nothing**_ to stop the rising crime, homelessness, and drug addiction crisis tearing my beloved home state apart.

I’m running for U.S. Senate because Americans deserve better than the _**failed**_ leadership they’ve been stuck with for _**years**_.

It’s time for a change in D.C., and I’m the right person for the job.

The latest polls in Washington show that my opponent and I will be neck and neck, and I’m getting nervous. We’re finally closing in on Murray, but I need your support to cross the finish line.

Can you endorse my campaign to help me take the lead to save Washington?

Tiffany Smiley

name: Tom Fitton
subject: We Are Winning in the Courts…But We Need Your Help!
body:
You are one of our loyal supporters, so you know how Judicial Watch is working hard every day to fight for the rule of law and against public corruption and unlawful government secrecy

| |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

Your Judicial Watch is on a winning streak in the courts _striking down radical Leftist laws_ that discriminate based on race, gender, ethnicity, and sexual orientation.
_And I need to know YES or NO_...[will you give your support to Judicial Watch, so that we can continue to fight to stop the Left from undermining our bedrock American principles of "_equal_ _opportunity " and "equal protection under the law?"_](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60261&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60261&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

As you know, where others talk, _Judicial Watch acts_ ...and where it counts..._in the courts_.

I'm pleased to report that your Judicial Watch is rolling up important victories against the radical Left's attempt to advance programs and laws that _create discrimination_ in America... _discrimination based on race, on gender, on ethnicity, on sexual orientation_.

Why? _So that they can divide Americans against each other for their own political_ _gain_.

But the Left didn't count on having to deal with Judicial Watch, so let me quickly recap for you _three of our victories_ this year in this important area of our work...

**In January** , the City of Asheville (NC) settled a Judicial Watch federal civil rights lawsuit we had filed on behalf of a North Carolina citizens group seeking to overturn a city-sponsored scholarship program that excluded individuals who were not Black.

And the Asheville City Council settled our lawsuit by agreeing to remove all racially discriminatory provisions from the scholarship program, as well as from a related program that provides grants to educators... _a clear victory for the rule of law_!

**In April** , your Judicial Watch scored another major victory when a California court ruled unconstitutional the state's racial, ethnic and LGBT quota for corporate boards of directors. The court granted Judicial Watch's motion for summary judgment in our lawsuit on behalf of three California taxpayers who challenged the constitutionality of this _quota_ scheme.

We argued that "**_Laws that explicitly distinguish between individuals on racial or _****_ethnic, sexual preference, or transgender status grounds fall within the core of the prohibition of the equal protection clause. "_**

And in its April ruling that shook the Left and the state's liberal political establishment to its core, the court agreed with Judicial Watch and ruled the quota unconstitutional under California's constitution!

**Then in May** , _another_ California court delivered _another_ victory to Judicial Watch and _another_ blow to the Left when it struck down a 2018 diversity mandate (Senate Bill 826) which required every publicly held corporation headquartered in California to have at least one director "_who self-identifies her gender as a woman_ " on its board by December 31, 2019.

After a 28-day trial, the judge in this case agreed with Judicial Watch lawyers (who had again sued the state's Attorney General on behalf of three California taxpayers) and "_determine[d] that SB 826 violates the Equal Protection Clause of the California Constitution and is thus enjoined. "_

So, just a few weeks apart, Judicial Watch lawyers persuaded _two_ California courts that _two_ different quota schemes were unconstitutional and delivered _two_ stinging defeats to the radical Left's unprecedented attacks on anti-discrimination.

**And our earlier settlement in North Carolina successfully reasserted the principle that discrimination based on race against _any_ racial group is impermissible.**

So I need to know if you support our _continued_ investigations and litigation to stand firm __for__ the principle of "equal opportunity and protection under the law" and __against__ illegal discrimination.

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60261&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

As a conservative, you know that Judicial Watch’s commitment is to uphold the U.S. Constitution and the rule of law... _and that includes our laws against racial discrimination_!

But the radical Left's Marxist commitment to dividing Americans against each other is being played out in _many_ arenas and localities...and that means Judicial Watching must continue to lead the fight against the radical Left on multiple, critically important fronts, including:

* Exposing the use of taxpayer dollars to indoctrinate elementary and high-school students with noxious, Marxist and racist Critical Race Theory (CRT) in more and more states and communities;
* Filing federal civil rights lawsuits on behalf of public school teachers fired from their jobs for exercising their First Amendment free speech rights and criticizing CRT and other extremist programs in their schools (we just won when we reached a settlement on behalf of one of our teacher clients in Massachusetts);
* Filing friends of the court briefs in support of challenges to race-based admissions programs at both private and public colleges and universities, including Harvard and the University of North Carolina where our arguments prevailed in recent rulings;

You see, all of these efforts...research, investigations, filing federal and state open records law requests, and lawsuits...come with very real price tags attached to them.

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60261&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

But I believe, as I'm sure you do, that our work countering the Left's efforts to corruptly pit Americans against each other is worth it...

...especially since we are virtually the "only game in town" when it comes to taking on the Biden Justice Department, liberal politicians in Congress and state legislatures...plus the corrupt liberal media, who are all working hand-in-glove with the Marxist Left to destroy our laws against discrimination.

We want to keep on winning for your values as we seek to educate Americans about corruption of the rule of law by the radical Left... _[but we need you to help us](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60261&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)_!

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60261&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

No one is fighting harder for you than your Judicial Watch, and we can do more if you will help again today. I look forward to welcoming you to the Judicial family of contributors!

Sincerely,

Tom Fitton
President

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60261&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)

| | I invite everyone to my town hall and campaign trips. I answer all inquiries, phone calls, and emails — even those who disagree with me. I do it because I would represent all of us, more than my party and ideological circle. I want the voter to be informed. I encourage constituents — especially Jack Bergman — to debate and bring us tough questions. How can voters be informed when candidates refuse to debate or hold town halls? Voting based on the party isn't an informed voter; it isn't the crown jewel of our democracy. We can and should do better to preserve our American democracy. We are not just functionaries of our parties. This election isn't just Democrat vs. Republican; it's dignity and integrity vs. Bergman's deceit and deception. I am Dr. Bob running against Jack Bergman. Please share our messages with your family and friends in Michigan's 1st District. Help others get to know us and understand our character and principles — then, vote on what is important to you, your family, and your friends. Unlike my opponent, I support women's rights and private medical decision-making. I support your freedoms, our constitution, and your right to vote. I support education, healthcare, and the environment. Most importantly, I will never dishonor or try to undermine the will of the people or our democracy. We need principled leadership in Michigan's 1st District. I intend to bring integrity back to this Congressional seat. My opponent counts on division and discord, uninformed voters, and a disengaged electorate as a campaign strategy. Unaccountability is an embarrassing, undemocratic strategy to hold on to power. Help us spread the word by forwarding this email to your contacts in Northern Michigan and the UP, [retweet this](https://www.votedrbob.com/so/fcOD1f0Zq/c?w=BxvcXwMsiZii3cqrdIzzprIMXlfvFH-oxn-OONTZXtQ.), and if you agree with my positions, get out the vote, volunteer, and encourage your friends and family to register. Thank you for your consideration, support and generosity. -Dr. Bob If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

name: Stacey Abrams
subject: A quick personal story
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ABRAMS FOR GOVERNOR |
body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Hello Derek,

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1992?refcode=sa_em_220915_B1_DebateTeamStory_S1_T1_SYA_30open_RS&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=7475%2E1862389%2EoZQZYF ]In just a moment, I’m going to ask you to donate to our campaign to
build One Georgia — where every Georgian has the opportunity to thrive.
But before that, I wanted to share a story with you about a $20 bill.

My high school debate team was the only one in the southern half of
Mississippi, so we would travel to New Orleans to debate other teams.
These trips were big deals because we got to spend the weekend away in the
city.

Unlike the other kids on the trip, I didn’t come from a family with a lot
of money to spend on fun trips. You see, my father was a shipyard worker
and my mother a college librarian — who sometimes made less than the
custodian who worked there. In a sea of middle-class students, we barely
got by.

Despite that, my parents always handed me a $20 bill for incidentals every
Friday morning before I left. But that $20 weighed heavier than it did for
most students that got to participate in debate.

It meant that one of my siblings wasn’t doing something they wanted to do
that weekend. It meant that my parents gave up something they needed at
the store that week. So to me, that $20 bill meant that I had to do
everything in my power to save it.

When my friends went out to celebrate on those debate nights, I made up
excuses like homework or book reports to avoid going out and spending that
$20. I was sure my parents would be proud of me — for saving $20 for them
and the rest of my family.

But when I showed my parents that $20 bill at the end of the season, I
told them how I avoided my friends to never spend their money. I explained
how I thought they would want me to save that money. I thought they would
be proud. But they weren’t. That’s when my mom told me:

“Stacey, we gave you that money because we knew you needed to be with your
friends. We wanted you to have opportunities and new experiences. We know
you didn’t have as much as everyone else. But our job was to invest in
you, so one day, you could have more.”

That’s what I failed to consider. I didn’t understand that my parents made
sacrifices for me because they wanted me to thrive — not just survive.

Right now, we are in a moment that takes me back to that day. Georgia has
a $5 billion surplus that Brian Kemp is hoarding. We’re told that this
money needs to be hidden away — that Georgians are not entitled to
Medicaid expansion or affordable housing or support for small businesses.

As governor, I will ensure we invest that money into Georgians instead of
stashing it away only to give $10,000 tax cuts to the rich. Because I’m
running in order to open the doors of opportunity for people all across
our state — regardless of their background or zip code. We deserve it.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1992?refcode=sa_em_220915_B1_DebateTeamStory_S1_T1_SYA_30open_RS&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=7475%2E1862389%2EoZQZYF ]But I need your help to get there,
Derek. I’m humbly asking you to
invest in our campaign so that we’re able to invest in Georgia. Can you
chip in to my campaign right now? Anything you can give — a $20 bill or
whatever you can afford right now — will make a real difference.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1992?refcode=sa_em_220915_B1_DebateTeamStory_S1_T1_SYA_30open_RS&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=7475%2E1862389%2EoZQZYF ]DONATE

Thanks for sticking with me,

Stacey Abrams

| Fellow activist,

Today I’m writing to you about a legal theory so radical — and so dangerous to our democracy — that last week **the bipartisan group of all 50 state supreme court justices** came together to urge our nation’s Supreme Court to reject it. It could, in essence, give state legislatures unfettered power over our elections, with no oversight by state courts, laws, or **_even their constitutions_**.

Unfortunately, the far-right activists who spent hundreds of millions of dollars to get this majority in power are urging for its acceptance, and four of the six conservative justices have already signaled some favorability to the so-called independent state legislature (ISL) theory.

**[Fellow activist, I’ll explain more about this theory in a moment. But first, for those of you who don’t have the time or already know about ISL, would you consider chipping in $10 today? If it becomes law, we may not get another chance to vote our values or empower anyone to do the same, so we urgently need to make the most of this election in Pennsylvania on November 8th.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/50760101/367103443/-632654605?refcode=EM_FR_220915ISL_N_KP_90DO_9_NG_N_L1&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzkwOTIwIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImZkMjA3OWNlLTJiMzUtZWQxMS1hZTgzLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=-7lAq5_Ltm0xJN9RcA70aCiwy3pYymMcspuvkCV2OYg=)** [DONATE NOW](https://click.everyaction.com/k/50760105/367103444/-632654605?refcode=EM_FR_220915ISL_N_KP_90DO_9_NG_N_B1&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzkwOTIwIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImZkMjA3OWNlLTJiMzUtZWQxMS1hZTgzLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=-7lAq5_Ltm0xJN9RcA70aCiwy3pYymMcspuvkCV2OYg=) Here’s the core of why this case has garnered headlines like **“This Case Before the Supreme Court Could Unravel Democracy for Decades” (_Esquire_) and “The court case that could transform U.S. elections” (_Politico_)**.

According to the radical theory’s proponents, the U.S. Constitution gives state legislatures alone the power to regulate elections, subject only to Congressional regulations, because there is no explicit mention of the judiciary. The Conference of Chief Justices and many others have thoroughly debunked this interpretation, but that means little with such a radical far-right majority as we now have on the U.S. Supreme Court.

As a result of this interpretation, the theory’s proponents argue no one has the authority to make state legislatures follow their own constitutions. Seriously. In their own words, **they would have it so “nonlegislative actors... cannot invoke state constitutions as a basis to strike down or willfully ignore clear laws,” including legislative districts and other matters of voting rights.**

The theory reached the U.S. Supreme Court as a defense of North Carolina’s Republican state legislature who gerrymandered **10 of the state’s 14 house seats where the state voted only 50.1% Republican in the 2020 presidential election.** This is how it could play out in practice in other states including Pennsylvania.

_ISL could even pave the way for legislatures to totally overturn election results and appoint their own electors, as nearly happened in legislatures across the nation in 2020._

**[Fellow activist, the Supreme Court is expected to rule on this case next June, creating yet another threat to free and fair elections. clean_body: And this could be our last election without it. = | Fellow activist, Today I’m writing to you about a legal theory so radical — and so dangerous to our democracy — that last week the bipartisan group of all 50 state supreme court justices came together to urge our nation’s Supreme Court to reject it. It could, in essence, give state legislatures unfettered power over our elections, with no oversight by state courts, laws, or even their constitutions. Unfortunately, the far-right activists who spent hundreds of millions of dollars to get this majority in power are urging for its acceptance, and four of the six conservative justices have already signaled some favorability to the so-called independent state legislature (ISL) theory. = = Here’s the core of why this case has garnered headlines like “This Case Before the Supreme Court Could Unravel Democracy for Decades” (Esquire) and “The court case that could transform U.S. elections” (Politico). According to the radical theory’s proponents, the U.S. Constitution gives state legislatures alone the power to regulate elections, subject only to Congressional regulations, because there is no explicit mention of the judiciary. The Conference of Chief Justices and many others have thoroughly debunked this interpretation, but that means little with such a radical far-right majority as we now have on the U.S. Supreme Court. As a result of this interpretation, the theory’s proponents argue no one has the authority to make state legislatures follow their own constitutions. Seriously. In their own words, they would have it so “nonlegislative actors... cannot invoke state constitutions as a basis to strike down or willfully ignore clear laws,” including legislative districts and other matters of voting rights. The theory reached the U.S. Supreme Court as a defense of North Carolina’s Republican state legislature who gerrymandered 10 of the state’s 14 house seats where the state voted only 50.1% Republican in the 2020 presidential election. This is how it could play out in practice in other states including Pennsylvania. subject: We can’t go backward on protecting our environment
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY POLIS FOR COLORADO
body:
This is a big priority for Colorado's future.

Team, Colorado’s blue skies, waters, and majestic open spaces are more than an economic driver. They’re a part of our way of life — and as your Governor, I’m determined to protect them for your kids, my kids, and every future Coloradan to enjoy. That’s why, over the last four years, we’ve:
* Put the state on a path to reach 100% renewable energy by 2040
* Doubled the amount of publicly accessible state parks
* Made historic investments in clean air while strengthening our water infrastructure
* Provided resources to help firefighters and first responders combat wildfires — while undertaking the most wildfire mitigation work in recent history.

**Climate change is a reality we cannot deny, Team. But together, we can protect our air, water, and public lands for future generations — while creating good-paying clean-energy jobs all across the state.** **[If that’s a mission you believe in, I would love your support, Team — because we’re up against right-wing special interests who want to undo all the progress we’ve made. body:
Please keep Michael on the road meeting Coloradans by helping us hit his mid-month goal! |
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50762816/367107278/721416609?refcode=header&amount=25&amounts=10,25,50,100,250,500,1000&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYTVmNWE5Yi0yZTM1LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eQYP4wkREbrbjZVhwkKHe4nUH11HGBX8QSIQgIF7L7A=)
Folks, You meet so many good people when you’re married to Colorado’s Senator. Michael, the girls, and I have traveled every corner of our state together: marching in the Pueblo Fiesta Day Parade; greeting volunteers in towns from Montrose to Grand Junction and everywhere in between; listening to farmers, teachers, and young people in every small community. Michael and I make it a point to go everywhere we can, and connect with as many communities as we can. How else can he serve all the people of Colorado? I’m not so sure that’s how our opponent sees it, though. **Because right now, with just a few weeks until Election Day, Joe O’Dea is in Miami — at a swanky fundraiser with Dr. Oz, JD Vance, and the MAGA Republican brass.** Michael has built his campaign around the people of Colorado, and that’s partly why I’m reaching out today. [**Can you please chip in by midnight to help us reach our campaign’s mid-month fundraising goal? The team tells me we’re 289 donors short with just a few hours left.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50762817/367107279/1091168796?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_MMG_AC_20220915_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYTVmNWE5Yi0yZTM1LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eQYP4wkREbrbjZVhwkKHe4nUH11HGBX8QSIQgIF7L7A=) | | **[DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50762818/367107280/1091168796?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_MMG_AC_20220915_PM2_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYTVmNWE5Yi0yZTM1LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eQYP4wkREbrbjZVhwkKHe4nUH11HGBX8QSIQgIF7L7A=)**
---
They say you can judge a person by the company they keep. Michael has always stood by the hardworking people we meet across the state.
Our opponent has made clear that he stands with Rick Scott, Mitch McConnell, and all their MAGA friends at that mansion in Miami. His campaign is supported by their $331 million warchest, plus his own personal fortune, and a new CO GOP poll shows him within 1% of flipping Michael’s seat.
That means the next few weeks will be really difficult, but I’ve seen Michael and this community win tough races before. If we stick together, we’ll win again.

clean_body: Please keep Michael on the road meeting Coloradans by helping us hit his mid-month goal! | = Folks, You meet so many good people when you’re married to Colorado’s Senator. Michael, the girls, and I have traveled every corner of our state together: marching in the Pueblo Fiesta Day Parade; greeting volunteers in towns from Montrose to Grand Junction and everywhere in between; listening to farmers, teachers, and young people in every small community. Michael and I make it a point to go everywhere we can, and connect with as many communities as we can. How else can he serve all the people of Colorado? I’m not so sure that’s how our opponent sees it, though. Because right now, with just a few weeks until Election Day, Joe O’Dea is in Miami — at a swanky fundraiser with Dr. Oz, JD Vance, and the MAGA Republican brass. Michael has built his campaign around the people of Colorado, and that’s partly why I’m reaching out today. = | | = They say you can judge a person by the company they keep. Michael has always stood by the hardworking people we meet across the state. Our opponent has made clear that he stands with Rick Scott, Mitch McConnell, and all their MAGA friends at that mansion in Miami. His campaign is supported by their $331 million warchest, plus his own personal fortune, and a new CO GOP poll shows him within 1% of flipping Michael’s seat. That means the next few weeks will be really difficult, but I’ve seen Michael and this community win tough races before. If we stick together, we’ll win again. = | = Thank you for all you’ve done for Michael and our movement. I hope to see you on the campaign trail soon. Peter, When the Supreme Court overturned Roe v Wade - as if that weren’t bad enough - they also threatened marriage equality. Now, Senator Tammy Baldwin (D-WI) has introduced legislation that will codify marriage rights into law, to prevent the Court from overturning itself and taking our rights away. But of course, yet again, the filibuster stands in the way. name: Karen Greenhalgh
subject: Tax Rebate Checks Are on the Way!
body:
| | |
---
Dear Folks, In January, it was evident that the Commonwealth’s revenues were strong. Not only did we have the money to give much needed raises to our teachers and law enforcement officers, we also made big investments in transportation and other key services – without raising taxes. More importantly, we were able to reduce the tax burden on Virginians by $4 billion – and some of that money is probably on its way to you in the coming days and weeks. The General Assembly, working hand-in-hand with Governor Youngkin, was able to include one-time rebates for Virginians who filed an income tax return and had a tax liability of at least $250. The end result is that most taxpayers are getting checks of up to $250 per person or $500 per couple. Checks and direct deposits will begin going out this Friday, and will be sent out in the order in which people filed their taxes. If you filed early, you should expect a direct deposit or check soon! The Department of Taxation will have a lookup tool available on September 19th that will let you see how big your rebate will be and when you can expect to receive it. [Click here to see the Department of Taxation’s information page on the rebates.](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/23a9f17af7861f4f16f79d307c796b93/37923/c15c862801a18b09/bef282cc379ae928c3d6b838967d376c/37923) As always, if I can ever be of service to you, please don’t hesitate to reach out. It’s an honor to be the voice of the 85th District.

| | INTRODUCTION TO THE NEGOP 2023 LEGISLATIVE PLAN
---
| | At August 20, 2022, SCC meeting, the NEGOP approved the 2023 Legislative Plan for Nebraska, 108th Legislature, 1st Regular Session, 2023. Believing that... “Nebraskans deserve a better and brighter future. They desire policies that put them first instead of policies that stand in their way. The Nebraska Republican Party supports a Legislative plan building a path for a brighter tomorrow. We have full confidence in the potential of Nebraskans to create a future for themselves and their families filled with peace, prosperity, and opportunity.” To that extent, the [2023 Legislative Plan](https://www.ne.gop/so/14OD18IF7/c?w=fq9yUKj_-vuGAyOlb7bhk1mqi_TPcL2d4n1fkUc26RI.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubmUuZ29wLzIwMjNsZWdpc2xhdGl2ZXBsYW4iLCJyIjoiZDg5MDZjNGEtMWUwYy00ZWRhLTAzYzgtMDBhZjEyYjNiZDBmIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiNDE4YzE3NjEtZWRkMy00YzFhLWIwNjQtYzBiYWM5ZDAyNjRmIn0) consists of seven bullet points to that end. For the next several weeks, these bullet points will bring focus to our platform and values creating messaging opportunities for the NEGOP and our candidates. We want the Republicans of Nebraska equipped with the knowledge of the 2023 Legislative plan and how this plan aligns with the NEGOP Platform “planks”. This plan will be our conservative values put into action towards the goal of influencing policy in our state. Below is the first bullet point to highlight: Legislative Plan 2023MAKE OUR ELECTIONS SECURE BY MAKING IT HARD TO CHEAT
* The foundation of our self-governance is liberty, and the core expression of the people’s liberty is the ability to cast their ballots in free and fair elections. Every eligible Nebraska voter should have the opportunity to cast one ballot at one time that is counted once. Anything that fails this simple test is a failure of the system, and people committing voter fraud must be held accountable.

o Require voters to have photo identification and eliminate ballot harvesting (2023 PHOTO ID INITIATIVE) ([Sec of State Voter ID Ballot Initiative](https://www.ne.gop/so/14OD18IF7/c?w=JeyyWOAt0mV5RLl4TJQ9oIJNYmhgi2HH9VqWMrjqHC0.))o Adopt ballot security measures to ensure no counterfeit ballot is countedo Ban dark money groups from giving money to election officials to influence electionso Allow people at the county level to determine how their votes are countedo Change how Nebraska allocates its presidential electors to a “winner take all” system
* NEGOP PLATFORM [SUB-SECTION STATEMENT](https://www.ne.gop/so/14OD18IF7/c?w=BUed_1em2Tpdr_C-8XwuZXUXIxg30V2FOIDR2lFtBVE.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubmUuZ29wL2VsZWN0aW9ucyIsInIiOiJkODkwNmM0YS0xZTBjLTRlZGEtMDNjOC0wMGFmMTJiM2JkMGYiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiI0MThjMTc2MS1lZGQzLTRjMWEtYjA2NC1jMGJhYzlkMDI2NGYifQ) ON “ELECTIONS”: The integrity of elections is one of the most critical issues in our republic. To secure our elections for future generations, we support requiring government-issued picture ID for voting and proof of citizenship at the time of voter registration. To guard against unfair practices and guarantee an open and transparent auditing process, we support a requirement that each vote cast in all elections be documented by a paper record in addition to any digital ballot cast. Because of its potential for abuse and fraud, the Nebraska Republican Party opposes ballot harvesting. We oppose ranked-choice voting. The Nebraska Republican Party supports current state and local partisan elections and supports the expansion of partisan elections to all elected offices, including the state legislature.

Nebraskan’s want and need secure elections. Securing the election process continues to be a focal point not just in our state but in our country. Specifically, 36 states have passed voter ID legislation. In 2021, five states passed photo Voter ID legislation with over 71% of the voters voting “YES”. To help influence Election Accountability and Voter Verification in the 2023 Unicameral session, would you consider donating today? Your donation of $25 will go towards our efforts to pass the VOTER ID BALLOT INITIATIVE ON NOVEMBER 8TH.

Washington Republicans are scared of how effective he has been fighting for Pennsylvanians on issues like COVID relief, protecting health care for seniors and low-income families, and growing the local economy. So they've made him one of their top targets this year.

With just 54 days to go until Election Day, the rules for how to vote are changing, and voters across the state are now left in the dark. We don’t have time to reflect on these new changes – instead, we need to act right away and make sure voters have all the information they need to participate in this November’s election. Our team is launching an emergency = to ensure every Delawarean can practice their sacred right to vote in November. = = Earlier this year, Democrats successfully passed legislation that would allow vote-by-mail to continue in the 2022 election after it was first enacted in our 2020 elections. And Delawareans took that change to heart, opting to vote-by-mail in huge numbers this past primary. Our campaign has already identified thousands of voters who plan to vote by mail again in November, and it’s on us to make sure they know of this urgent change. We need to reach out to each and every one of these voters to help make sure they have a new plan for Election Day – but this is no small feat. Democrats up and down the ballot are counting on us to help turn out as many voters as possible, and this new change in our election systems could completely upend our efforts. By launching our = , we’re working to make sure every voter has what they need to vote this November, but we need to make sure we have the funds to continue our work until the very end. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | **= | | = | = | | = | = | | = Thank you, Team LBR for Delaware Congresswoman Lisa Blunt Rochester is a Democrat representing the First State, Delaware. Murray has been in office for 3 decades and has done _**nothing**_ to stop the rising crime, homelessness, and drug addiction crisis tearing my beloved home state apart.

I'm running for U.S. Senate because Americans deserve better than the _**failed**_ leadership they've been stuck with for _**years**_.

It's time for a change in D.C., and I'm the right person for the job.

subject: Now is the time

body:
The challenges we face today are the greatest in living memory. Historic
attacks on the right to vote, on a woman's right to choose, and on our
children's right to be free of gun violence will either destroy this great
state or will be overcome by the resolve and power of the people of Texas.

Greg Abbott has prioritized extreme fringe policies instead of expanding
health care, fixing the grid, or improving public education. He signed the
nation’s most extreme abortion bill into law with no exception for rape or
incest. And he refuses to lift a finger to reduce gun violence after six
major mass shootings have occurred on his watch.

Despite all of that — or maybe because of all of that — Texans are
standing up to be counted in the fight for a far better Texas. It's
inspiring how the people of this great state are choosing to meet the
moment. Already, 90,000 volunteers have signed up for voter contact shifts
to reach millions of voters wherever they are across Texas. And we have
taken this campaign to literally every part of the state — showing up for
everyone and writing no one off.

But we face a real challenge in overcoming the millions of dollars that
Greg Abbott was able to raise from special interests before we ever
entered the race. He'll use that to lie to voters about my record and try
to keep them from turning out. And there's a chance he'll succeed if we
don't have the resources to fight back.

more organizers, open new field offices, run ads, and ultimately reach all
of the voters who will decide this election. Will you make a
$3 contribution today to help us raise $2,500,000 before
midnight?

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220915-1.GOlGiB&refcode=ema20220915-207994&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1020&akid=207994%2E444211%2EIds87z ]Contribute $3

We have less than two months to win this election, and we need everyone to
give everything they've got. I will continue to relentlessly travel this
state, meet with as many voters as physically possible — but I also need
the resources to overcome Abbott’s money advantage if we're going to win.

Now is the time to focus everything we have on overcoming and winning.
It's never been more important or urgent.

Let's do this.
Beto

I hate reaching out with not-great news. But this is really important.

**[Can you rush a $5 donation right now to help us close this gap? The latest and most dangerous attempt to undermine our market and
force a woke agenda on America is called the Environmental,
Social, And Governance..

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osCi3JWh3N

Friend,
the unholy alliance between big government and woke corporations
is growing and it could not be MORE concerning.

FIGHT
BACK: END ESG >> SIGN OUR PETITION

The
latest and most dangerous attempt to undermine our market and
force a woke agenda on America is called the Environmental,
Social, And Governance Movement (ESG).

ESG rules
are a dangerous form of red-tape regulation. Left-wing activists
want to impose government ESG rules as a way to assert control
over Wall Street and Main Street businesses.

ESG has
been commonly described by the Left as criteria for making
investment decisions to "aid environmental or social causes you
care about." But really, they only want it to benefit causes THEY
care about.

ESG is
essentially a social credit score for businesses that would favor
radical, liberal beliefs and PUNISH pro-American, traditional
values. END ESG NOW >>

How will
the Left punish companies with ESG? With a low ESG score,
companies may not qualify for loans or investments. The Left will
use cancel-culture tactics to pressure other companies to cut
business ties. Government contracts will only go to the "right"
companies with the "right" ESG scores. The Left will deplatform
companies from needed services-like banking, advertising, and
internet services.

Who does
ESG hurt? Everyone! Customers, employees, small businesses, big
businesses, investors, and anyone with a retirement account will
suffer under an ESG regime. We've seen what socialist control of
businesses looks like in China, Venezuela, the USSR-it's not
good!

What kind
of companies would be punished under ESG? American oil and gas
companies. Companies that don't pledge to go 100% green.
Companies that fail to mandate CRT trainings for employees.
Companies that don't push "woke" gender ideology. The list goes
on and on…

And it's
a BIG DEAL! Once you cross the Left, they will use ESG to target
you.

As I
wrote in my latest op-ed, Elon Musk found this out the hard way.
After his public stance on free speech and efforts to purchase
Twitter, his "electric cars, solar, and clean energy" company was
excluded from the ESG index.

ESG is
infecting every level of government and finance: last May,
Biden's pick to lead banking regulation said "the way we
basically get rid of those carbon financiers is we starve them of
their sources of capital." This is the heart of ESG - financially
starving any companies who aren't in line with the progressive
ideology.

We've
already watched as this administration has shuttered pipelines,
denied permits, and cut off development-bank financing for oil
and gas - all in line with the so-called ESG agenda.

At
Heritage Action, we're working to fight back and prevent the
spread of ESG rules and regulations. Through education, activism,
and legislation, we can fight ESG, just like we did CRT (Critical
Race Theory). But we need your support to raise awareness and
STOP ESG!

Will you
join us by signing the petition to END ESG now?
https://heritageaction.com/support/

ESG
policies are nothing but a thinly veiled attempt to radically
transform corporations into social justice warriors and exclude
conservatives from competing in our economy.

We cannot
allow this to continue.

Make your
voice heard by signing your name now.

SIGN YOUR
NAME

Thank you
in advance.

Jessica
Anderson

As Campaign Manager for Tom Malinowski’s reelection battle, I’m heading into the final seven weeks of this campaign with a healthy dose of righteous rage.

**Despite the MANY ways the GOP’s extremist arm is attacking New Jerseyans, Tom’s opponent, Kean Jr., is dead set on supporting Trump — “no matter what,” in his own words.**

So I’ve got some questions for Kean Jr. Like, does “no matter what” include when Trump assaults our democracy, or when the GOP opposes lifeline economic support for New Jerseyans? How about when extremist Republican politicians try to take away reproductive freedom and access to basic healthcare?

Unfortunately, we already know the answer. Kean Jr. voted AGAINST codifying abortion access in New Jersey law. He OPPOSED the Inflation Reduction Act and its aim of lowering costs for families. He's accepted $80k in campaign donations from insurrectionist members of Congress despite knowing that our democracy is at a tipping point.

Here’s the thing. **[Kean Jr. is clinging to the MAGA agenda because he’s scared.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50773308/367130412/-66827181?amount=10&refcode=TM_EM_FR_3MO_20220915_1_4&refcode2=268e13fb-3d35-ed11-ae83-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82MzYzOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNjhlMTNmYi0zZDM1LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ylekfw8PJpyb2ejmwernezpRdU-owkxdFf8FVuDnacs=) He’s scared of the responsibility of actually answering to his constituents, or coming up with solutions to the problems we’re facing.** In fact, he’s avoided that responsibility the entire time he’s been a state senator — refusing to hold a single community town hall in his 20 years in office. Now, he’s promising to take that exact same attitude to Congress: ensuring Trump has another yes-man to depend on, and New Jerseyans have a complete void instead of the leadership they deserve.

We have seven weeks left to make sure that doesn’t happen. And at the end of the month, we’ll hit the single most important deadline in this entire election: the FINAL end-of-quarter FEC reporting deadline when all our fundraising numbers will go public.

The election is less than two months away, and I need your support,
Derek.

But before I ask for your help, you deserve to know why I’m running for
Lieutenant Governor of Wisconsin.

[ https://go.tonyevers.com/go/1570?amount=10&t=1010&akid=4725%2E1827488%2E0CMKRR ]I was born and raised in Wisconsin and believe everyone deserves the
opportunity to earn a good living, send their kids to good schools, and
have access to quality, affordable healthcare.

Wisconsinites want to live in a safe community. We want to respect basic
human and civil rights. And we want the planet to be here for our
grandchildren and beyond.

I will be an advocate for all Wisconsinites, focused on making a
difference in people's daily lives and putting our state first.

[ https://go.tonyevers.com/go/1570?amount=10&t=1011&akid=4725%2E1827488%2E0CMKRR ]I have the experience, passion, and skills to lead. That is why I’m
running for Lieutenant Governor, and my agenda is simple:

* Make sure the economy works for everyone, with jobs that provide a
living wage, and encourage and support entrepreneurs.
* Protect our shared values, keep our community safe, and ensure every
school is a great school.
* Make sure everyone has access to the world’s best healthcare here in
America.
* Honor our democracy and those who fought for equality by uniting
around our American values of dignity, respect, and opportunity.

I am not a career politician, I am a nurse and a businessperson, and I
believe we can do better.

Together, we can keep moving Wisconsin forward, but I need your help.

Fellow American,

Now that we’ve said goodbye to summer and entered autumn, **it’s officially GO TIME for the upcoming election!**

I am proud of the work my team and I have accomplished over the last 14 months. **_We’ve been marked as one of the seven critical races that could flip the House, and it’s drawing NATIONAL attention!_**

**But now is not the time to take our eye off the ball - not even for a second.**

**There are 54 days until the election; that’s less than two months!** So we must reach every single fundraising goal we set for ourselves, including our mid-month goal that ends tomorrow. [**Can I count on your help to reach it so we’re not left scrambling?**](http://links.georgeloganforcongress.com/u/click?_t=ab154d37b4f04f71ab6ab4c65effe590&_m=db074de7b64e4270a285312a86c98a77&_e=c9txX0qlkgFhnNQTUJcvNIr21DsvhhwUy-SH0UhsE1yA3qRAJYv-mQsMtHCLDiyem4VkbbW-ohw2LxLYQa-2lzzG0Mpdktyu4dbzwOLhhgAlSl3rjNV_LD-WSFJUJjNwvCmWRVk5I7GaKSvhTCc6v-PHbu7yO3-bG6qTSi-pmgDszY6iDwUixnJ7BiVkZtxSuKaQ4nZBHtV-ttl3aHnWYgmLmSV3jRBxLKgT-quUE_lYDty_Te31wKxROpH2MgH1uTe7UT-XPwzzC-n5ArlvNfQrFNbtAPiawKh9D2FncTm3g81twQtnA2ZPJsVWL4AkuPDJCD9vnLWtiJjOWpL7hKrYx8_S7ptLBGzKvuv4O5Gh8HEC2dBgK2OdTQFTy6xH2EswCwtPD-pJ4mLNqzzFNkz427yFxsfK-1xE9k3P5WM%3D)

| [**REACH MID-MONTH GOAL ››**](http://links.georgeloganforcongress.com/u/click?_t=ab154d37b4f04f71ab6ab4c65effe590&_m=db074de7b64e4270a285312a86c98a77&_e=c9txX0qlkgFhnNQTUJcvNIr21DsvhhwUy-SH0UhsE1yA3qRAJYv-mQsMtHCLDiyem4VkbbW-ohw2LxLYQa-2lzzG0Mpdktyu4dbzwOLhhgAlSl3rjNV_LD-WSFJUJjNwvCmWRVk5I7GaKSvhTCc6v-PHbu7yO3-bG6qTSi-pmgDszY6iDwUixnJ7BiVkZtxSuKaQ4nZBHtV-ttl3aHnWYgmLmSV3jRBxLKgT-quUE_lYDty_Te31wKxROpH2MgH1uTe7UT-XPwzzC-n5ArlvNRE3I2U0vekmzDBwjjTLtNDiIzTVMQ73ZxxlveUZXhxUkfOryA6mbUTwfei5iaD-PJ6Y0STJsUXsvIQ7tKtRVKuP3-5RSh0ZdhVre2V0oBybiMt-asENDQElOtWIVgMr-MXqi4pS8GAoPJgxPBwgA0Y%3D)
---

**Reaching this specific goal is vital.** You see, in two weeks, we are required to send our fundraising numbers to the Federal Election Commission (FEC).

My opponent Jahana Hayes and her team will look through our numbers and see how much more they need to raise to ensure they consistently outraise me. **_Keep in mind - they’re already outraising my campaign by 3:1!_**

But she won’t be the only one looking at our numbers. The Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee (DCCC) will look and see how far they have to reach into their deep pockets to save Hayes. **_Also, keep in mind that they’ve already purchased a MILLION DOLLARS worth of ad buys._**

We have a lot of work ahead of us these next 54 days, and frankly, I’m worried it’s not enough time. | | | Hello again from the road! I'm in Asia for an economic development mission and will also be giving a big speech on America's role in the world, the vision of _An America United_ , and global peace and prosperity. I'm working to strengthen ties with our partners in Asia. My wife Yumi, who's Korean-American, will be joining me for this final economic development mission as Governor of Maryland.
---
[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=96b171ff8fa34eb89314b2433106dae3&_m=acf50224214845c2a2943b56dbd3a7ff&_e=DNJEHx6iOMM6I0R_teIp3sVi_PAHKxi5r4i6cFn8liDMGvWIhUEVFoaviX0BgqzXGvD-LGn_UsVDPxba_d_cU9rgLKQ9XWgPqR59Sg0bDX_laJUO-KbPnHQchZDbJCMbE7DSn7zgIHqnNlFaqzcNYxVDTQaPwwusCeFR0t5K7b_ZmTIxd2wzMupuzXdMTMm2diVmFcg47VkxclOYR2wWxpE6AYRQU9T2FqxE36SjIcoHpKHwGHCANeuXo7iShfmOtrADA8C3qnfZjJH6H5nm3w%3D%3D)

While here, I hope to show our country what stronger ties with our allies can achieve. China and Russia pose a real threat to energy, national security, and our economy. **_But the partisan division in America doesn't have to be permanent._** _**An America United**_ was created to help find a better path forward for our country and the way our leaders solve problems. I still believe that we can come together for the greater good. It's going to take common sense leaders with the courage to stand up against partisan, toxic politics and put people first. Everyday the news is alerting us to the woke agenda that the Democrats are pushing, and it inevitably means that law abiding, good Americans are the ones who get the short end of the stick.

**When it comes to crime, punishment, and keeping our streets safe, Democrat’s are buying votes at the cost of the American’s lives.**

Eliza Fletcher, a teacher and mother of two, was kidnapped while out for a morning jog in suburban Memphis. And as I’m sure you saw, she was found brutally murdered. The culprit.... a repeat kidnapper and felon who was recently released on bail by a liberal judge.

The liberal woke policies enacted to try to create relief on jails and decrease recidivism have failed completely. Yet, the agenda for these WOKE politicians is simply to increase popularity among those in the population who feel as though they deserve a fourth or fifth chance and promise they won’t commit crimes again.

[Support me as I fight to keep our streets safe and fight against WOKE policies designed to put you in DANGER!](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zphgicu3q1bkqs2jjoheoutsdodhk5v0dv2j45qo_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9jm1pr7chh2bs)

**Democrats value VOTES more than YOUR SAFETY**

In Illinois, VIOLENT OFFENDERS are being released before trial without bail. The SAFE-T Act allows for defendants to be charged and released for crimes such as:

\- Arson
\- Robbery
\- Kidnapping
\- Second Degree Murder

Not to mention a host of others that are crimes in which great harm to people and communities occur. How can this happen!? How can we allow violent criminals to get free and roam our streets?

**Democrats are clearly more concerned about prosecuting people who fight for American values and freedom like myself and President Trump.**

They are not concerned about your safety. They are not concerned about your family.

**They only care that their policies help get votes from the very people wreaking havoc in our community.**

**That’s why it is imperative that we take back the House this November!**

We cannot get complacent and allow the Democrats to continue their reign of destruction. But they will, as long as they continue to hold that majority in the House of Representatives.

[Will you donate to my campaign today to help get me to Congress so I can fight for to keep you and your family safe?](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zs4pnh21k0r7jgvjgcmnka7dimgqnrlmunmuqj90_rp22sh2s8i66or6c9jm1pr7chh2bs)

As a true believer in the value of our Law Enforcement and upholding the laws of this great nation, I vow to support our Cops and fight against any policy enacted in any community that seeks to put upstanding citizens in danger for votes.

Thank you for your support!

Sincerely,
