body:
I wanted to take a second to re-introduce myself.
| | |
---
Peter, the last few weeks have been a whirlwind, to say the least. But now that we’re just weeks away from the general, I want to take a second to reintroduce myself and make sure you know who I am and why I'm running for Senate.
I've spent my whole life in Missouri. As a young girl growing up here, I watched my parents live the American Dream.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50779916/367136067/-1843232826?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk280-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OGI0ODM2Zi00MjM1LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8caMXegIf8QW4OeBlwa04UwZO5xkTkDbNO3WaJNy-FI=)
At a young age, my parents taught me that “to whom much is given, much is required.” That sense of duty to help others is what drove me to choose a life of service.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50779917/367136068/-1843232826?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk280-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OGI0ODM2Zi00MjM1LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8caMXegIf8QW4OeBlwa04UwZO5xkTkDbNO3WaJNy-FI=)
When I was a kid, I dreamed of becoming a nurse. To me, nurses were the real superheroes. They took care of people and saved lives. That’s what I wanted to do – so I set out to make it happen.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50779918/367136069/-1843232826?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk280-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OGI0ODM2Zi00MjM1LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8caMXegIf8QW4OeBlwa04UwZO5xkTkDbNO3WaJNy-FI=)
As a young woman, I fulfilled my dream of becoming a nurse. Right after nursing school, I worked at a hospital and cared for children, seniors, people who relied on Medicare and Medicaid for their healthcare, and folks from all walks of life.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50779919/367136070/-1843232826?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk280-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OGI0ODM2Zi00MjM1LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8caMXegIf8QW4OeBlwa04UwZO5xkTkDbNO3WaJNy-FI=)
During my time working in a hospital, I saw the importance of quality healthcare firsthand. As a nurse, I believe that every person deserves access to the very best medical care, and as a parent, I believe that everyone should have access to contraception and abortion care – full stop.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50779920/367136071/-1843232826?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk280-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OGI0ODM2Zi00MjM1LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8caMXegIf8QW4OeBlwa04UwZO5xkTkDbNO3WaJNy-FI=)
I’ve spent my life giving back and helping others, and now I’m running for U.S. Senate because we need a nurse's heart in Washington.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50779921/367136072/-1843232826?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk280-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OGI0ODM2Zi00MjM1LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8caMXegIf8QW4OeBlwa04UwZO5xkTkDbNO3WaJNy-FI=)
If I could go back and talk to any of the younger versions of myself in these photos, she wouldn't believe it if I told her we would one day be on the cusp of taking our heart of service all the way to the U.S. Senate. **I hope I am making her,****my family****, and – most importantly – you proud.**
Running a campaign with stakes this high is scary, for sure. Still, I'd be lying if I said I wasn't excited for November. **I know that on Election Day, we're going to prove to everyone that hope, compassion, and people-first politics _can_ win. **But I need your help to do that, and right now, we're falling $2,498 short of our next midnight grassroots fundraising goal.
**I'd really hate to miss a critical goal like this one so soon after our primary victory, so I have to ask you: **[Please, can you make a donation of $5, or whatever you can spare tonight, to power this campaign to November and help me bring compassion, honesty, and respect back to Washington?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50779922/367136073/-1843232826?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk280-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0OGI0ODM2Zi00MjM1LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8caMXegIf8QW4OeBlwa04UwZO5xkTkDbNO3WaJNy-FI=)

clean_body: I wanted to take a second to re-introduce myself. | | | Peter, the last few weeks have been a whirlwind, to say the least. But now that we’re just weeks away from the general, I want to take a second to reintroduce myself and make sure you know who I am and why I'm running for Senate. I've spent my whole life in Missouri. As a young girl growing up here, I watched my parents live the American Dream. = At a young age, my parents taught me that “to whom much is given, much is required.” That sense of duty to help others is what drove me to choose a life of service. = When I was a kid, I dreamed of becoming a nurse. To me, nurses were the real superheroes. They took care of people and saved lives. That’s what I wanted to do – so I set out to make it happen. = As a young woman, I fulfilled my dream of becoming a nurse. Right after nursing school, I worked at a hospital and cared for children, seniors, people who relied on Medicare and Medicaid for their healthcare, and folks from all walks of life. = During my time working in a hospital, I saw the importance of quality healthcare firsthand. As a nurse, I believe that every person deserves access to the very best medical care, and as a parent, I believe that everyone should have access to contraception and abortion care – full stop. = I’ve spent my life giving back and helping others, and now I’m running for U.S. Senate because we need a nurse's heart in Washington. = If I could go back and talk to any of the younger versions of myself in these photos, she wouldn't believe it if I told her we would one day be on the cusp of taking our heart of service all the way to the U.S. Senate. | Team,

Today is the beginning of Hispanic Heritage Month, a time for us to remember and honor Hispanic and Latino contributions to our state and the entire U.S.!

Originally just a week of remembrance, we now spend a full 30 days honoring the history and contributions of our Hispanic and Latino community.

In our region, these influences and contributions are easy to see. You can see it in our everyday lives; the clothes we wear, the food we eat, the music we listen to. They have helped build this nation, and our state.

You can also see it in non-obvious ways. You can see the contributions of Yuma-born Cesar Chavez, as workers in Arizona and all over the U.S. band together collectively to unionize and work for better working conditions, pay and benefits.

But we also want to recognize that politically, there’s a lot of progress still to be made.

We’ve made strides in recent years, but too often, our Hispanic and Latino communities are forgotten about. Far too often, they are dehumanized by extremist politicians, like Andy Biggs and Kari Lake right here in Arizona.

So while we celebrate the rich tradition, beautiful culture, and important contributions of Arizona’s Hispanic and Latino communities this month, let’s also commit to continuing to prioritize these communities and fighting back against their mistreatment.

Thank you to our Hispanic and Latino communities for all they do for Arizonans.

Sincerely,

AZ Dems

name: Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz
subject: I'm asking
body:
Derek,
It’s Minnesota Governor Tim Walz here – I want to explain why this week is so important to keep our state in Democratic hands.
Our race is one of the most closely watched races in the nation. Our chances to win were downgraded three straight times by election analysts, and Republicans just announced they will spend nearly seven figures against our campaign in September alone.
We can’t allow my extremist Repulican opponent – who has pledged to ban abortion, is anti-vax, and has threatened to imprison his political opponents over the Big Lie – win in Minnesota. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvawalz?refcode=20220915_CGVA_Walz]
On September 20, our campaign is required to disclose our year-to-date fundraising data publicly for the first time since we officially started the general election.
To ensure we leave no doubt that we are ready to win, we’re pushing hard to reach a grassroots goal of $250,000. And with just days to go before our reporting deadline next Tuesday, it’s clear we need to pick up the pace.
That’s why I wanted to ask you for a contribution personally – because if there was ever a time where we need your support, it is right now.
Derek, if you’re able, will you split a contribution of $25, $50, or more today between my campaign and CommonGood to help us hit our goal and spread our positive message that we know will lift us to victory? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvawalz?refcode=20220915_CGVA_Walz]
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvawalz?refcode=20220915_CGVA_Walz&amount=25]
DONATE $35 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvawalz?refcode=20220915_CGVA_Walz&amount=35]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvawalz?refcode=20220915_CGVA_Walz&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvawalz?refcode=20220915_CGVA_Walz&amount=100]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvawalz?refcode=20220915_CGVA_Walz&amount=250]
Donate ANY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvawalz?refcode=20220915_CGVA_Walz]
With your help, we know we can win this race. The stakes of this election couldn’t be more clear – from protecting reproductive freedom to defending our democracy to following science, taking action on climate change, fully funding our schools, and so much more.
Tens of thousands have already stepped up to fuel our campaign as we fight to keep Minnesota in Democratic hands and hold the line against my extremist Republican opponent, Scott Jensen, who would stop at nothing to drag Minnesota backward if he’s elected in November.
That’s why I’m asking for your help: grassroots supporters like you have helped build our campaign from the very beginning, and I know that you can help us hit our goal and boost our campaign to victory. Can you split a donation that works for you right now between my campaign and CommonGood? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgvawalz?refcode=20220915_CGVA_Walz]
I’m grateful,
Tim Walz

Arlington, VA 22215

body:
The immediate impacts of the Inflation Reduction Act are real.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=932%2E61531%2EH4ExCD)
Hello,
I was proud to be one of the Democratic legislators to help pass the Inflation Reduction Act in Congress last month. It was a historic moment and major win for all Americans, no matter who you voted for, and I look forward to continuing to work side-by-side with Americans nationwide to build on this victory for our communities.
**The immediate impacts of this legislation are real.** I’ve got a few numbers for you that bear it out:
* By allowing Medicare to negotiate with Big Pharma to lower prescription drug prices, Americans will save an estimated **$265 billion** over the next decade.
* Out-of-pocket drug costs are now capped at **$2,000 per year** for seniors, saving them thousands on life-saving medications.
* And health insurance premiums will be reduced for the 23,000 Vermonters receiving coverage through the Affordable Care Act, saving each of them **$1,700 annually**.

This bill is truly the beginning of the end for corporations’ unchecked price gouging, and we’re starting to ensure they put the people over their corporate profits.
**But let’s be clear: None of this is possible if Mitch McConnell is in charge.**
Neither he nor any of his GOP colleagues supported the Inflation Reduction Act, and if he becomes majority leader once again, he won’t just put an end to our future plans, he’ll try to undo the progress we’ve already achieved.
[**With the election quickly approaching, I need the support of this grassroots movement to help secure our Democratic majority in the Senate, and I hope I can count on you. Please consider pitching in $5 or anything you can to power this campaign right away.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4186?t=3&akid=932%2E61531%2EH4ExCD)

* Marco's opponent raised more in **ONE MONTH** than he did in THREE months
* Two polls showed that he was officially **TIED** with this far-Left opponent
* **Reports showed his opponent had DOUBLE the grassroots supporters that he has**
* His opponent spent over **$20 MILLION** attacking him and smearing his name

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

We are now less than 8 weeks from Election Day in November and we are
statistically tied with Brian Kemp. We all know what a grassroots movement
can accomplish in Georgia — but after the 2020 election Kemp passed an
extreme voter suppression law that makes it easier for a single person to
challenge legal voters.

And now, conspiracy theorist groups are swarming this election to
challenge thousands of voters in counties with large brown, Black and
Democratic populations across Georgia. Just look:

Trump Allies Back Mass Challenge to Voter Eligibility in Georgia
VoterGA — a group backed by former Trump advisor Michael Flynn — “filed eight
boxes Monday containing what its leader says are 37,500 challenges to voters in
Gwinnett County... The Gwinnett challenges bring the total this election cycle to
about 65,000...”

(Bloomberg, 9.1.22)

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1992?refcode=sa_em_220915_B2_ConspiracyTheorist_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=7780%2E1862389%2E1blD3Q ]That’s why we need your help to reach out to voters and empower them.
With an unprecedented number of challenges to voters’ eligibility being
brought forth by Trump’s allies this election, we need a wave of support
to educate them on how to overcome this and other barriers that anti-voter
activists may try to throw in their way. Will you chip in
$5 to grow our team and reach as many voters as possible?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1992?refcode=sa_em_220915_B2_ConspiracyTheorist_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=7780%2E1862389%2E1blD3Q ]DONATE

In a state where the 2020 presidential election was decided by a margin of
fewer than 12,000 votes, we know exactly how radical, anti-democracy
Republicans expect this to play out.

They think they can win this election by suppressing Democratic voters.

But we say no way.

Stacey’s fight for protecting voting rights in Georgia spans decades. From
her days of activism at Spelman College to her time in the Georgia House
of Representatives — her advocacy for the freedom to vote has already made
waves in elections past.

As governor, Stacey will fight back against the extremist voter
suppression measures Brian Kemp has put in place during his tenure and in
the years before.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1992?refcode=sa_em_220915_B2_ConspiracyTheorist_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=7780%2E1862389%2E1blD3Q ]With only weeks until the election, time is running out to make sure
that Georgia’s voters are equipped and ready for what’s coming their way
this November. And we’re counting on you to get us there,
Derek. Can you chip in
$5 today to give voters the tools they need to overcome
these latest attacks from Trump’s allies?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1992?refcode=sa_em_220915_B2_ConspiracyTheorist_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=7780%2E1862389%2E1blD3Q ]DONATE

name: Derek Schmidt
subject: ICYMI: To rise above her record, Kansas Governor Laura Kelly needs more than a suitcase
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY DEREK SCHMIDT FOR KANSAS, INC
body:
Elevating Governor Laura Kelly out of the mucky incompetence of economic shutdowns, school closures and unemployment fraud that’s come to characterize her governorship is going to take| | |
---
| | **ICYMI: To rise above her record, Kansas Governor Laura Kelly needs more than a suitcase
** **By Dane Hicks** [_September 12, 2022, The Anderson County Review_](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=7c84c96e24764c2fac6540629e28fffa&_e=wAQ19BTYaZtO94blFQzhthP82F3mIjk6VJHFD5SdsOKOk0FaLoz4MlCjpNxAETB-PaS5-Q4jluPtTZ6SNPbrHE9CjbBGXmurqJNO1g41T4W-X9sGN-uGVC9ZwNxbtxAKaOj5Y_bhAtOodLPQyIOQ-B9_yftup53TGKEseFdnhwPRGjOSlNcEmU_kBsx0CFUBs0nrSaKCkgFGVdd9KmIe2Aphfqf2We6PX-lOu8tAWQ4ure-UwVSEoc1AAgc7ThYc_9g_-xbVfIY1iHkXB5QCLyXqutEAS3jZKeTTtQ93XkQmuW_65pboQKEk3MnwpKZj) Elevating Governor Laura Kelly out of the mucky incompetence of economic shutdowns, school closures and unemployment fraud that’s come to characterize her governorship is going to take a bigger suitcase than the one she stood on at the Kansas State Fair gubernatorial debate last week.

Seeking some kind of apparent “equity” with her opponent Republican Derek Schmidt, who’s 6-foot 5 inches tall, organizers of the first governor candidate debate of this year’s election decided to perch the more vertically challenged Kelly on an equipment case to raise her profile onstage. The move was no doubt to escape the kind of imagery that fueled the classic 1988 Saturday Night Live spoof of the Bush/Dukakis presidential debate. In that classic, the diminutive Dukakis (Jon Lovitz) climbed aboard some unseen elevation contraption at the podium, and to the sound effect grind of electric motors, hoists himself first taller than Dana Carvey’s George Bush, then back to parity.

The scene made those in attendance at Hutchinson wonder: What’s next? Put Kelly in a camouflage helmet and perch her in a Kansas National Guard tank for her next television commercial?

Unfortunately that extra foot of prosthetic stature doesn’t allow Kelly to rise above her record as governor, nor does her whiny refrain of “Sam Brownback” every time Schmidt talks about leadership, ideas, policy and common sense decision making.
The fact is that now ending her first term, Kelly’s boots are irretrievably stuck in the mess she made and the values she tried to hide in her first election four years ago. She’s been revealed as just another Blue State Joe Biden order follower, emulating Democrat policy in lockstep with failed national dictums and hoping Kansas voters will stay drunk with borrowed Covid money long enough to get her reelected.

Like Joe Biden, Kelly’s hits just keep coming. The latest is the revelation that on Kelly’s watch hackers bilked more than $400 million in Kansas unemployment funds from Kansas employers’ accounts – no one’s exactly sure of the real number even yet. This is money that comes right out of the unemployment accounts funded from the pockets of small businesses and other employers of all sizes to protect Kansas workers in the event they lose their jobs. Now not only is the money gone, but hundreds of thousands of Kansas workers have to worry that their social security numbers – a hot commodity on the black market – are now likely being sold to illegal immigrants, criminals or others for use in other identity theft scams.
The breach of Kansas DOL information that Kelly’s lack of oversight allowed to happen may end up costing billions – and may even cost lives – before it’s all said and done.

But that’s just the latest. Kelly’s legacy of throwing the state’s businesses and school children on the Covid hand grenade in 2020 is inescapable, even when she tries to deflect to the topic of the never-ending addiction to more school funding.
“Fully funding schools can only work if you don’t lock the kids out of them after they’re fully funded,” Schmidt quipped onstage.

And to Kelly, that great education is more reserved for men who say they’re women than it is for everybody else. If some boy goes all Shania Twain and says he really “feels like a woman” and beats your daughter in the 200 meter hurdles at Beloit High School or even at the University of Kansas and bumps her out of a scholarship, Kelly thinks that perfectly fine. She vetoed – twice – legislation that would have banned transgender competition in female sports in Kansas. So much for “equity.”

That boys and girls are different should be pretty easy fact, but Kelly doesn’t even recognize facts when the numbers are right in front of her. So eager was she to deflect from the fact that she piloted an asteroid into the Kansas economy, she outright lied about the state’s jobs recovery a few weeks ago. No big deal, unless you’re one of the 18 percent of Kansas workers still out of work because she scuttled the state’s economy two years ago and it’s yet to come back.

Like other Democrat governors and mayors, Kelly’s mantra has been to follow the lead of the worst big-government thinkers in our country and to ignore the outcome of those policies. Now at election time, raising Laura Kelly up out of her own awful leadership is going to be some heavy lifting indeed.

[Click here to read the whole piece in _The Anderson County Review._](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=7c84c96e24764c2fac6540629e28fffa&_e=wAQ19BTYaZtO94blFQzhthP82F3mIjk6VJHFD5SdsOKOk0FaLoz4MlCjpNxAETB-PaS5-Q4jluPtTZ6SNPbrHE9CjbBGXmurqJNO1g41T4W-X9sGN-uGVC9ZwNxbtxAKaOj5Y_bhAtOodLPQyIOQ-LBSibxAsY0jmBp8WCnTwW9QTGONGkOvGl-uoYqbdo_iUG4GY70LlL7VlHN9tzosOLCoufD3aPSPnDQgmVf3YyCgxcJpOrHyp_l7uOkuwH1gx_Wl8z_SVQ4y1kt_kKJY1Ek9g6ZMIWu43DlCbHq60Ieyn9RroU2DhHUydOwfe5rI)

subject: Hispanic Heritage Month
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Bennet for Colorado
body:
I’d like to talk about the work Michael Bennet and I have been doing to help Colorado’s Latino communities grow and thrive. |
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50784936/367148403/721416609?refcode=header&amount=25&amounts=10,25,50,100,250,500,1000&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZDZjYjBiNC00ZjM1LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SkhXDmjkoJLFakUFzLbLSJCP_0COECw6eh0EpCXBow0=)
Orale Compa, This is Senadora Julie Gonzales! Michael invited me to reach out in celebration of Hispanic Heritage Month, and I’d like to take this opportunity to talk about the work we’ve been doing together to help Colorado’s Latino communities grow and thrive. As the Chicana daughter of a rancher and a teacher, let me say one thing. **The needs of our Latino communities aren’t so very different from those of _all_ Coloradans: good schools, quality health care, reproductive freedom, and the opportunity to build a better life.** Michael understands that, and he and I have stood side-by-side to fight for solutions to our Latino communities’ everyday challenges. As a former school superintendent himself, Michael has seen the difference a quality education makes in kids’ lives — and how poverty impacts educational attainment for too many children. He’s working to combat child poverty as a leading advocate of the expanded Child Tax Credit, and he's fighting to make college more affordable and expand access to career and technical training and apprenticeships. Michael has not forgotten the founders’ message that everyone deserves to build a life here in America. Together, he and I have fought to keep families together and pass commonsense immigration reform that provides a pathway to citizenship, and grows our economy. Republican opposition has blocked many of the changes we need, but Michael is still fighting for us. And Michael has always been clear that Coloradans’ reproductive health care decisions should be between them and their doctor. As a State Senator, I helped codify abortion protections into Colorado law, and I'm grateful to have Michael in the Senate — defending that progress from the threat of a nationwide abortion ban. **I’m proud to support Michael Bennet in one of the most competitive Senate races in the country.** Please join me in voting for him this November so he can continue to fight for Colorado’s Latino communities in the US Senate! Mil gracias, Senadora Julie |

clean_body: I’d like to talk about the work Michael Bennet and I have been doing to help Colorado’s Latino communities grow and thrive. | = Orale Compa, This is Senadora Julie Gonzales! Michael invited me to reach out in celebration of Hispanic Heritage Month, and I’d like to take this opportunity to talk about the work we’ve been doing together to help Colorado’s Latino communities grow and thrive. As the Chicana daughter of a rancher and a teacher, let me say one thing. The needs of our Latino communities aren’t so very different from those of all Coloradans: good schools, quality health care, reproductive freedom, and the opportunity to build a better life. Michael understands that, and he and I have stood side-by-side to fight for solutions to our Latino communities’ everyday challenges. As a former school superintendent himself, Michael has seen the difference a quality education makes in kids’ lives — and how poverty impacts educational attainment for too many children. He’s working to combat child poverty as a leading advocate of the expanded Child Tax Credit, and he's fighting to make college more affordable and expand access to career and technical training and apprenticeships. Michael has not forgotten the founders’ message that everyone deserves to build a life here in America. Together, he and I have fought to keep families together and pass commonsense immigration reform that provides a pathway to citizenship, and grows our economy. Republican opposition has blocked many of the changes we need, but Michael is still fighting for us. And Michael has always been clear that Coloradans’ reproductive health care decisions should be between them and their doctor. As a State Senator, I helped codify abortion protections into Colorado law, and I'm grateful to have Michael in the Senate — defending that progress from the threat of a nationwide abortion ban. I’m proud to support Michael Bennet in one of the most competitive Senate races in the country. Please join me in voting for him this November so he can continue to fight for Colorado’s Latino communities in the US Senate! name: Maggie Hassan
subject: I'm officially the nominee
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
body:
#

_Note: This email is from Senator Maggie Hassan of New Hampshire, who’s up for re-election in an extremely close race that could determine control of the Senate this November._
It's official,
I am honored to once again be the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in New Hampshire.
With the primary now behind us, I wanted to take a moment to say thank you to you, my supporters. At every turn, the backing of people just like you has allowed us to build a campaign that this team can and should be proud of.
With the general election now officially underway, we’ll need to redouble our efforts. [**That’s why I’m coming to you today to ask if you will split $5 between Alex Padilla and me and become a General Election Founding Donor.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-sep22-mh.1Hv6P_&refcode=em220915-1-30&t=1&akid=994%2E159979%2Et3kog7)
The fight to protect this seat – and with it, our Democratic Senate majority – is only going to get harder. The smear campaign is only going to intensify, and the over $53 million the GOP is spending against me is only going to increase.
But you know what I say, team? **Bring. It. On.**
I’ve never been one to run from a challenge, and there is too much on the line in this race to back down. Whether it’s continuing to deliver real solutions on the issues that matter most to Granite Staters, or blocking a McConnell nationwide abortion ban, it all begins with winning here in New Hampshire.
**And I hope that I can count on your support as we fight to do just that, because the final sprint to the finish line starts right now. And it starts with you.**
**[DONATE](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-sep22-mh.1Hv6P_&refcode=em220915-1-30&t=2&akid=994%2E159979%2Et3kog7)**
We need people like you in this fight, friend, because the fate of our Democratic Senate majority will hinge on this key battleground race. [**So please, split a $5 contribution between Alex Padilla and me and join this team as a founding donor of the general election.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-sep22-mh.1Hv6P_&refcode=em220915-1-30&t=3&akid=994%2E159979%2Et3kog7)
With every good wish,
Maggie Hassan

Paid For By Alex Padilla for Senate
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com . Email is a very important way we communicate with supporters like you, but if you want to, you can [ unsubscribe here.](https://act.alex-padilla.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=4&akid=994%2E159979%2Et3kog7)

body:

---
| |
---
| |
# Happy Hispanic Heritage Month!

Hola Mi Gente!

Today, the DNC is kicking off Hispanic Heritage Month by[ announcing our latest Spanish language ad buy](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=04784cbcec&e=d6c5c7d7ec), this investment is over half a million dollars, to highlight how President Biden and Democrats’ leadership is delivering for Latino families and to hold Republicans accountable for pursuing an extreme agenda. This is on top of the seven figure investments the DNC has made to reach Latino voters this cycle.
---
| [DNC Spanish Press Release](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=a816fe6b2e&e=d6c5c7d7ec) **The Hill:**[ DNC announces half-million dollar bilingual ad investment for Hispanic Heritage Month](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=08db1d4f04&e=d6c5c7d7ec) “The Democratic National Committee (DNC) on Thursday announced a half-million dollar ad campaign in Spanish and English to commemorate Hispanic Heritage Month. The campaign will feature ads on Spanish-language radio stations and print, as well as bilingual digital ads... The Hispanic Heritage Month investment comes on top of a seven-figure investment announced by the DNC in spring as part of ‘Adelante,’ the party’s 2022 Latino outreach program.” **EFE:**[ Demócratas anuncian inversión de medio millón en publicidad para latinos](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=2c382c85b8&e=d6c5c7d7ec)
“El Comité Nacional Demócrata (DNC) anunció este jueves una asignación de más de medio millón de dólares en una campaña publicitaria dirigida a los votantes latinos cuando quedan 54 días para las elecciones de medio término.”

**Latin US:**[ Demócratas preparan su mayor inversión en medios enfocada a los votantes latinos: “Sabrán lo que Biden ha hecho por ellos”](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=ce9f5a61b8&e=d6c5c7d7ec)
“El Comité Nacional Demócrata (DNC) estadounidense, que gestiona el día a día del Partido Demócrata, aborda las elecciones legislativas de noviembre con un foco especial en el votante latino, para el que contempla una campaña específica en los medios para luchar contra la desinformación. ‘Los latinos van a oír hablar de los demócratas más que nunca’, apuntó este miércoles en una conferencia telemática María Cardona, consejera del DNC y antigua asesora en la creación y divulgación del programa de enlaces e iniciativas para la comunidad latina ‘ADELANTE’.”
---
|
---
If you’d like to volunteer with us this month, please join us for our Adelante x Llamando Contigo Latino phone banks! We’ll be hosting multiple phone and text bank events weekly featuring Latino candidates and elected officials as surrogates. Our first one is TONIGHT September 15th with Candidate Michelle Vallejo from TX-15.
| [RSVP Here](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=1eccd10a0f&e=d6c5c7d7ec "RSVP Here")
---
| Here’s a few things that DNC has done this cycle to reaching Latino voters:
* As part of the DNC’s commemoration of Hispanic Heritage Month, it is announcing over half a million dollars in paid media investments that will run over its entirety, including ads on Spanish-language radio stations, Spanish-language print and community newspapers, as well as digital ads in both English and Spanish.

* This cycle, the DNC has already done several rounds of paid media, in addition to this announcement today, on Spanish-language radio and print in over a dozen states, including Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Michigan, Nevada, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Texas, Wisconsin, and more.

* Today’s announcement comes in addition to the seven figures in midterm investments[ that the DNC announced in the spring](https://collegedems.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b3a52587106e5f265f227782b&id=182571ace7&e=d6c5c7d7ec) as part of the launch of its signature Latino community outreach program Adelante.

* Last week, DNC Chair Jaime Harrison joined the DNC’s Hispanic Media Director Maca Casado and DNC Advisor Maria Cardona on a call with Latino reporters from across the country to highlight the DNC's historic investment in outreach to Latino voters through its signature program Adelante ahead of the midterm elections.

* The DNC has also partnered with sister committees and state parties to invest in Latino coalition-building and organizing in targeted coordinated campaigns across several states including Arizona, Georgia, Florida, Michigan, Nevada, New Mexico, Pennsylvania, Texas, Wisconsin, and more.

* As part of its efforts to hire staff that represents the community it serves, the DNC hosted a Campaign Readiness Project bootcamp focused around recruiting, training, and placing in battleground states, bilingual staff.

* This effort helped increase bilingual staff on the ground at all levels of experience and put particular focus on recruiting for bilingual communications, coalitions and organizing staff to help build the pipeline for both 2022 and 2024.

Best,
Michelle Villegas

Today, the DNC is kicking off Hispanic Heritage Month by, this investment is over half a million dollars, to highlight how President Biden and Democrats’ leadership is delivering for Latino families and to hold Republicans accountable for pursuing an extreme agenda. This is on top of the seven figure investments the DNC has made to reach Latino voters this cycle. | The Hill: “The Democratic National Committee (DNC) on Thursday announced a half-million dollar ad campaign in Spanish and English to commemorate Hispanic Heritage Month. The campaign will feature ads on Spanish-language radio stations and print, as well as bilingual digital ads... The Hispanic Heritage Month investment comes on top of a seven-figure investment announced by the DNC in spring as part of ‘Adelante,’ the party’s 2022 Latino outreach program.” EFE: “El Comité Nacional Demócrata (DNC) anunció este jueves una asignación de más de medio millón de dólares en una campaña publicitaria dirigida a los votantes latinos cuando quedan 54 días para las elecciones de medio término.” Latin US: “El Comité Nacional Demócrata (DNC) estadounidense, que gestiona el día a día del Partido Demócrata, aborda las elecciones legislativas de noviembre con un foco especial en el votante latino, para el que contempla una campaña específica en los medios para luchar contra la desinformación. ‘Los latinos van a oír hablar de los demócratas más que nunca’, apuntó este miércoles en una conferencia telemática María Cardona, consejera del DNC y antigua asesora en la creación y divulgación del programa de enlaces e iniciativas para la comunidad latina ‘ADELANTE’.” | If you’d like to volunteer with us this month, please join us for our Adelante x Llamando Contigo Latino phone banks! We’ll be hosting multiple phone and text bank events weekly featuring Latino candidates and elected officials as surrogates. Our first one is TONIGHT September 15th with Candidate Michelle Vallejo from TX-15. | "RSVP Here" | Here’s a few things that DNC has done this cycle to reaching Latino voters: As part of the DNC’s commemoration of Hispanic Heritage Month, it is announcing over half a million dollars in paid media investments that will run over its entirety, including ads on Spanish-language radio stations, Spanish-language print and community newspapers, as well as digital ads in both English and Spanish. This cycle, the DNC has already done several rounds of paid media, in addition to this announcement today, on Spanish-language radio and print in over a dozen states, including Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Michigan, Nevada, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Texas, Wisconsin, and more. Today’s announcement comes in addition to the seven figures in midterm investments as part of the launch of its signature Latino community outreach program Adelante. Last week, DNC Chair Jaime Harrison joined the DNC’s Hispanic Media Director Maca Casado and DNC Advisor Maria Cardona on a call with Latino reporters from across the country to highlight the DNC's historic investment in outreach to Latino voters through its signature program Adelante ahead of the midterm elections. The DNC has also partnered with sister committees and state parties to invest in Latino coalition-building and organizing in targeted coordinated campaigns across several states including Arizona, Georgia, Florida, Michigan, Nevada, New Mexico, Pennsylvania, Texas, Wisconsin, and more. As part of its efforts to hire staff that represents the community it serves, the DNC hosted a Campaign Readiness Project bootcamp focused around recruiting, training, and placing in battleground states, bilingual staff. This effort helped increase bilingual staff on the ground at all levels of experience and put particular focus on recruiting for bilingual communications, coalitions and organizing staff to help build the pipeline for both 2022 and 2024. subject: Thank You for Volunteering in the primary! We are Organizing activities for the General!
body:
Hello,

Thank you guys for sharing your information and being willing to help us win the primaries. I just wanted to introduce myself (Bobby) and let you know that I will now be your contact to the campaign. I am very excited to get planning some activities that with your help and others will make sure Laurel crosses the finish line in first. If you are receiving this email, it means we were unable to reach you by phone. If you are still available to come out and show your support I would ask that you please respond to this email with a few things about yourself that will be listed below. We have the honor of being able to represent a district that is vast in size. This information will help us organize and maximize your impact but keeping you close to home. For one reason or another we don't not have this information for everyone, if you are willing to share it please do.

Bobby Combs

Ed delivered remarks today at City Hall in Portland expressing his strong support for the men and women in Blue, and explained why Chellie Pingree is bad for law enforcement.
* * *
| [Click Here to Support Ed as he Supports The Blue](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=6c31531a61&e=f8a0a76a2b "Click Here to Support Ed as he Supports The Blue")
---
|
* * *
**Ed Thelander Calls on Pingree to Support Law Enforcement as Crime Spree Rattles Portland**
---
|
* * *
Thank you everyone for coming. A special thanks to the active-duty and retired members of the law enforcement community here today. My message to you today is this: We are here to support you.

We want to continue to live in America’s safest state. Violent crime is rising in Maine, and I believe it will get worse as people become desperate this winter. Much of the blame for this rise in crime are the results of the policies pushed by Representative Pingree and her progressive colleagues in Washington.

For those of you that have never served in law enforcement, I ask you to at least take a few ride-alongs with those who protect you. You will see a variety of situations – any of them could change in an instant – and could change or even end someone’s life.

Add to those few hours that you spend next to their shoes, not in them, that they are human. They are wives and husbands and parents, and also someone’s children.

Serving in law enforcement requires a willingness to walk into any situation to help people anytime. I know how hard it is. I work with and train law enforcement here in Maine. We ask a lot of these men and women. They serve us bravely and selflessly.

The few that do step forward to serve and protect deserve great respect. They are kind and caring, and switch to fearless and brave in an instant. The individuals who serve in law enforcement do not ask for help easily. When they do, we must respond with a caring and supportive hand.

Retired FBI Agent and Reserve Police Officer Todd DiFede in May wrote a very well-thought out letter to Congresswoman Pingree asking for just that, help. Not for himself, but for help with the mental health and wellness of the law enforcement community.

Her response, which is available here today, along with Mr. DiFede’s letter, doesn’t address the issue of Officer Wellness at all. Instead, in paragraph two, Pingree lays out what she perceives as the sins of law enforcement, alleging that police officers kill nearly 1,000 people each year, and disproportionately kill people of color.

In her response to Mr. DiFede, Pingree continues, “we must address the scope and magnitude of the harms caused by police brutality.” She then proceeds to boast about the laws she has supported cutting resources to law enforcement.
Before pivoting to issues unrelated to her constituent’s request for help, Pingree wrote, “I recommend that you reach out to your local representatives to share your thoughts on this issue.”

She has no idea what is needed to support the folks that take care of us while we sleep. It doesn’t seem to occur to her to take care of those that take care of us. Her response was clear: “I do not support you; go ask someone else.”

Those who serve in law enforcement work hard. They are under equipped, under paid, understaffed, and as is apparent with Pingree’s words, under appreciated.

This disregard for our Police is contagious. It has affected recruiting. It is causing hate and disrespect from the very people they took an oath to protect.

We are here today to tell the men and women in law enforcement that we support you. We will get you the help, training, and the resources you need to take care of us.

At a time when our law enforcement professionals need our support more than ever, the record is painfully clear: Chellie Pingree is bad for law enforcement.

I call on my opponent to take a stand in support of the men and women in blue and support HR 3080, Congressman Don Bacon’s “Back the Blue Act”.

I also call on Representative Pingree to join me in a debate on public safety issues to showcase for voters the wide gap between our two approaches to the critical issues facing the dedicated members of our law enforcement community.

Thank you.

body:
In honor of Hispanic Heritage Month, I want to share a few thoughts about my family, my background, and our country.| | | [](http://links.jasonforvirginia.com/u/click?_t=b7c680598d5648c3aaffcf8cea32abf4&_m=20f81820c0584ad4aaa8ef0d7cae57a9&_e=VDn4KSZfyi66X41BHNNZJGwiJrH_NTk494AgVuBX_MA_eQscF-mS8KhqxX6OZaa_Wf43dSVcrUiFScyO_J3kjzTrYPr5fm9LA0M4nZIBy1XUWlSDDwNk_Ss3_wOAz7AjMV-ndA8gsfuTkR9rQma8AfCq4v_ag0cBG8dg12dpt-VLR6mMW94YHlEdb0bcH4_NFLQR22Ehm3BOpefzVLiDAhCbpzoUmpwYmER63ok78k8d6G2zR183NTbfrewRO5IAQ0Z8mQr-bRFUQGOzHGHbsgthqqeVfBaPO7Uvf3aylOveEooW9F3HXnROcQUJ5Gcm2j6HL0AW69R7FF5fRfnRk93PTpEJTbqXO9mGZeOpPHQ%3D)
---
Friend, Hispanic Americans have made incredible contributions to our country, and today we are leading the fight against the woke, liberal agenda that threatens to uproot the American Dream. I owe my historic win as Virginia’s first Hispanic Attorney General to my mother, who fought to achieve the American Dream. **Her experience living in Fidel Castro’s Communist Cuba is why I will** _**ALWAYS**_**fight to reject socialism.** As a young woman, my mother left her home –– and everything she knew –– to pursue freedom and a better future. I’m eternally grateful that our country welcomed her with open arms, allowing her to make her American Dream a reality.
---
[](http://links.jasonforvirginia.com/u/click?_t=b7c680598d5648c3aaffcf8cea32abf4&_m=20f81820c0584ad4aaa8ef0d7cae57a9&_e=VDn4KSZfyi66X41BHNNZJGwiJrH_NTk494AgVuBX_MA_eQscF-mS8KhqxX6OZaa_Wf43dSVcrUiFScyO_J3kjzTrYPr5fm9LA0M4nZIBy1XUWlSDDwNk_Ss3_wOAz7AjMV-ndA8gsfuTkR9rQma8AfCq4v_ag0cBG8dg12dpt-VLR6mMW94YHlEdb0bcH4_NFLQR22Ehm3BOpefzVLiDAiW00xnhhR3bsYcpdxF08AoLmG3xNzSaFSSmgUMoMZtxmRVrbXHFMddpdNo2MyumpPAx_zlzih6TBWMjbti3STK20Fyyfdi9qUcXsG-BVL1nESpo5CL80XGKQXcEd94vQfiWCkAbX_2q4_Qfyszw32M%3D)
---
**We’ve seen this playbook before –– and we know how this movie ends.** Limiting free speech, expanding government rule, and labeling political opponents as “domestic terrorists” always results in LESS freedom and MORE tyranny. As Attorney General, I am honoring my heritage by fighting to ensure the socialism, tyranny, and chaos we fled **_do not undermine freedom here in America_** _._ **_[In honor of Hispanic Heritage Month, will you join me and sign the petition to defend the American Dream?](http://links.jasonforvirginia.com/u/click?_t=b7c680598d5648c3aaffcf8cea32abf4&_m=20f81820c0584ad4aaa8ef0d7cae57a9&_e=VDn4KSZfyi66X41BHNNZJGwiJrH_NTk494AgVuBX_MA_eQscF-mS8KhqxX6OZaa_Wf43dSVcrUiFScyO_J3kjzTrYPr5fm9LA0M4nZIBy1XUWlSDDwNk_Ss3_wOAz7AjMV-ndA8gsfuTkR9rQma8AfCq4v_ag0cBG8dg12dpt-VLR6mMW94YHlEdb0bcH4_NFLQR22Ehm3BOpefzVLiDApA2Tf6QgnvE_WMDXTsMnUOHCVk1QirHzJvxKhs5naYvA57FewEHezIiqlSUMfqt4e5KMMjyhZ4ZQRObWZOCxom6aKrzArYigfzhr4YgdyU24NOFVYHOo_8LhnCLSLjf0HOhAgi9BuyjYrqGxCtuRyA%3D)_ **
---
[**SIGN THE PETITION: DEFEND THE AMERICAN DREAM**](http://links.jasonforvirginia.com/u/click?_t=b7c680598d5648c3aaffcf8cea32abf4&_m=20f81820c0584ad4aaa8ef0d7cae57a9&_e=VDn4KSZfyi66X41BHNNZJGwiJrH_NTk494AgVuBX_MA_eQscF-mS8KhqxX6OZaa_Wf43dSVcrUiFScyO_J3kjzTrYPr5fm9LA0M4nZIBy1XUWlSDDwNk_Ss3_wOAz7AjMV-ndA8gsfuTkR9rQma8AfCq4v_ag0cBG8dg12dpt-VLR6mMW94YHlEdb0bcH4_NFLQR22Ehm3BOpefzVLiDAlUzyw_hqFwMRzNBx0AL3it5TCMyPLXOJ4MYDhG57jhDoBT5ILoQBCRsWjPxulywHAxIICT1d7d_p_nhXlwQUwqJFXYjbiQ1Zw7nMsanD--lGx_QagI1rS6Wjh3CGYKAnOsaS-pVohfiZ7FebBS6unw%3D)

Future generations are counting on us to preserve the greatest country in history. _[**Please, do your part and add your name to defend the American Dream.**](http://links.jasonforvirginia.com/u/click?_t=b7c680598d5648c3aaffcf8cea32abf4&_m=20f81820c0584ad4aaa8ef0d7cae57a9&_e=VDn4KSZfyi66X41BHNNZJGwiJrH_NTk494AgVuBX_MA_eQscF-mS8KhqxX6OZaa_Wf43dSVcrUiFScyO_J3kjzTrYPr5fm9LA0M4nZIBy1XUWlSDDwNk_Ss3_wOAz7AjMV-ndA8gsfuTkR9rQma8AfCq4v_ag0cBG8dg12dpt-VLR6mMW94YHlEdb0bcH4_NFLQR22Ehm3BOpefzVLiDAg6adnW0bSNdVYOUD8zoy1wLR2vA2JGYdcDvwngZEQsgoICXyIDzZBi5Ixr4Vd--D8hf_oxP_U-XjL1mK4W6ZaEW9hFiLexCeFWVJBQ4sDV4lJFGi6vLYRyRzb7rKRUy8VOsojaFRv1YHW5LCwuV-r0%3D)_ Thank you,Jason Miyares

Fellow Conservative,

**Can you guess what percentage of Democrats said they would cut and run if the U.S. were invaded?** **_52%_**

**How pathetic.** Makes me wonder how many Democrats in Congress would have answered in the affirmative if they were polled.

I can tell you one thing first: the day in 2015 that an Islamic terrorist armed with more than 270 rounds of ammunition decided he’d like to blow up a train killing hundreds of civilians, I didn’t waiver; **my friends and I identified the threat and neutralized it. clean_body: | | Friend, We just received the endorsement of the National Education Association Vermont - NEA-VT. Brenda is so thrilled to be Educator approved. ** The Vermont Chapter of the National Education Association is the largest union in the State, with over 13,000 members. They serve as a voice for the educators in our classrooms every day, giving their all to ensure a bright future for our state's children. We must support our workers full stop. We’re honored to have their support. In his endorsement, NEA president Don Tinney explained that “in a year when public education is under attack by right-wing extremists here and across the nation, it is crucial that we elect pro-worker, pro-education, pro-union candidates to the state’s leadership.” He argued “now more than ever, we need elected officials who are dedicated to supporting our already outstanding public schools and the people who work – and learn – in them.” ** | Our local public schools are Vermont's most important resource, and we need to do more to support Vermont children and teachers. Brenda is deeply committed to supporting our public schools: “I am absolutely honored to have earned the trust and support of the states largest union. Teachers are our backbone and it is time they are treated as such. I am a graduate of Brattleboro Union High School and the Windham Regional Career Center. I have taught extra curricular courses, after school courses and career center courses in public schools across the state. I have had the opportunity to watch our educators work tirelessly to ensure our children, the future of our state, have the best opportunity for success. I will have our educators backs as Governor.” Brenda will look out for Vermont teachers and represent their interests as Governor. name: Eric Sorensen
subject: Senate Republicans are planning a nationwide abortion ban. My opponent is staying silent.
body:
Peter,
Illinois’ 17th District is my home. I was born and raised in Rockford, and for the past several years I’ve lived in the Quad Cities area. My roots in this district run deep.

After meeting dozens of voters and knocking on countless doors, I can tell you what many of our residents are looking for in a candidate for congress. They want someone who:
* _They can trust to deliver the truth_ clearly and consistently
* _Will stand up for our community_ in Washington
* Will be unwavering in their _support for reproductive freedom_

_**In fact, recent polling shows that more than 70% of IL-17 residents are pro-choice.**_**** If elected, I will stand up for this supermajority, and I’ll push back against any attacks on reproductive freedom in Illinois and across the country.
**Meanwhile, my opponent Esther King is an anti-choice extremist. Even as Senate Republicans attempt a nationwide abortion ban, she remains staunch in her belief that stripping the constitutional right to bodily autonomy was the correct thing to do.**
King is hoping voters won’t notice, but we won’t let her get away with it, Peter. That’s because we have support from thousands of local Illinoisans whose votes will decide this race.
**With the super PAC spending headed our way, this is going to be a super close election. Please chip in a grassroots contribution of $5 today to help us pick up more momentum so we can defeat extremism in IL-17. **
You can use this customized link to donate: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-q3-2022?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50768464/367122422/1849287978?refcode=em-9.15.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZDNjNWNkZC0zODM1LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UWtCt3xgVaWI_FYOrQIMGLTe6qtxObE1rgMGTt3OCgo=)

Thanks for your support -- stay tuned for more soon.
-Eric

P.S. As we enter this next stage of the campaign, it’s going to be critical that we ramp up our fundraising to communicate to undecided voters that I am the only candidate who will fight for reproductive freedom. **It would mean a lot to me to see your contribution come in before midnight.**

It is now against the law for Hoosiers to have a safe and legal abortion. It’s without a doubt Senate Enrolled Act 1 will endanger women and little girls’ lives across our state. **This mandate is the worst form of government overreach, and generations of women for the first time will be forced to make dangerous decisions that put their lives at risk. ** Underprivileged women — especially Black and Brown Hoosiers in urban communities — will see their futures dashed or their lives be put in danger because an unchecked, radical Republican supermajority in the Indiana General Assembly put a small minority over the 83% of Hoosiers who wanted the state to maintain its existing laws. **The Indiana Republican Party cares more about being the first state to ban abortions in special session than actually tend to the kitchen-table issues voters actually care about most.** This very reason is why Indiana has an F-rated quality-of-life for families, a D- rating for its workforce, the most polluted waterways in the nation, and a C- rated education system. Indiana’s government is failing Hoosiers, because the Republican politicians in charge care more about special interests than actually creating a better future for our families. **There’s an opportunity for Hoosiers to immediately hold Governor Eric Holcomb and Indiana Republicans accountable at the ballot box on November 8.** Hoosiers can reject the GOP’s extremism by voting for Democrats who will put Indiana’s future — not some political agenda — first. **We know that it’s not going to be an easy task to turn out record numbers of Hoosier voters for Democrats on the ballot this fall, but with your help we can send a message to the Indiana Republican Party.** **[Can you make a monthly contribution of whatever you can afford to the Indiana Democratic Party today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/50769173/367125089/1643342139?recurring=true&refcode=idp-em-220915-sea1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNzgwNDVjYS0zOTM1LWVkMTEtYWU4My0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Pf_OskGsKDCVym9K4kOsbEf9LLOAjDY1Ka2My1TA3Vs=) We’ve only got two months left and we have to make every second, every dollar, and every vote count.** Your support during these final two months is crucial and being able to count on your monthly giving commitment allows us to invest now and make calculated campaign choices, so we’re not making rushed strategy decisions closer to early voting and Election Day. I’m reaching out today with an important message, and in a moment I’m going to ask you to** [chip in a donation to the Democratic Legislative Campaign Committee, the official Democratic Party committee to elect Democrats to statehouses.](https://an.dlcc.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953yunrDUt5-NmgrWwLBOHMAiI-J1eF7DD-Rs-arbSqEneeZOOT4L4OeXXBH8w4Hm05tJ6OdT44B5YGJ7A-65w9wK_Hw1fHs9FG1ewPb2D9DyYL8JuTlRC9y-YSZI-7A3orKkWzBX9jYfcU42Jlu6zE39ZS7sdHefwNspJrNiAgtZMxrN5Tmo5frPeP2Ietd-Ol0qSsTdN6k2GfNDb5hTLLtOmd70v4dM8lx7zdyvn3CDi_6mADrz-vjZQCD7_vPeX1Wz1qWlGrj6pS-37552N0ZWgGXXG9wv14uuv_8z7ZIcdwLHpZzVppp211rimwPdqhu50n7zvUDuHaAGPnIq7tb1oT-awOk0Kz4Rrb_hzH61t_pkBZ96t6oAF5gGovjwCqoOtcNoObMwyP7raqVMtWAUC0TDmL_dJJpg7gsANz7hjgHAXmyC-0w2DzeJefjVVT3mjV7J33RAeCdrWbYXDsXUPeVdNppqKOO4t8FCDb72aNJKgUHyovZ9op8SUm-0JU4F-bxxjfmsFX05hspLiIZT1-Yhku8I4atmyaPCYRBkVKphFUSdkV81tv2O00HCBxI/3ph/pV6AXh1lRbeXxbtHTgsFjQ/h1/0E8IMK1BkJEJ6m0hSA0x6rH0TjzPbVjgcBj_epgg_Ck) **But first, I hope you’ll take the time to read why:** As the Governor of Illinois, I’ve made it my mission to secure access to safe, legal abortion care at a time when GOP-led states across the nation are rapidly turning the clock back on our fundamental rights. subject: A higher standard

body:
‘Men who treat women like that in public, I fear how they treat them in private’
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220915-3395-header&t=1&akid=3395%2E2526796%2EE57W5r)
Since day one in office, Alexandria has fought hard to hold Congress to a higher standard.
So today, when a Republican representative from Louisiana disrespected Raya Salter – an energy justice lawyer who serves on the New York State Climate Action Council – as she testified during an Oversight Committee hearing, Alexandria spoke up loud and clear. She said:
_“In the four years that I’ve sat on this committee, I have never seen members of Congress – Republican or Democrat – disrespect a witness in the way that I have seen them disrespect you today. I do not care what party they are in, I’ve never seen anything like that [...] There’s more than one way to get a point across. Frankly, men who treat women like that in public, I fear how they treat them in private. We can be better than this.”_
This is not the first time that Alexandria has spoken up to hold those in power accountable for their actions – and it won’t be the last. Here’s why:
When incidents of violence or disrespect go unaddressed at the highest levels of government, it conveys that everyday actions of elected leaders in the United States of America don’t matter. But they do matter.
This behavior betrays the meaning and importance of the work that happens in the people’s Capitol. And it trickles down to the rest of the country. When this behavior goes unchecked, it says that treating colleagues or other professionals this way at your workplace is acceptable – when it is not.
From fighting to censure Representative Paul Gosar after he tweeted an animated video depicting him killing Alexandria and attacking the President, to holding Representative Ted Yoho accountable for calling Alexandria “a f— b—” on the steps of the Capitol – Alexandria will never shy away from holding her colleagues accountable and demanding a high standard of respect and integrity.
[We hope you’ll join us in standing in solidarity with Alexandria. Taking on the bullies (and worse) in Congress is tough work, and a small donation would go a long way towards showing her that she has a movement standing behind her. ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220915-mu.3gt3OF&refcode=em20220915-3395-P_FND_RES_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3395%2E2526796%2EE57W5r)

We hope Alexandria inspires you today to keep demanding the respect you and your colleagues deserve.
Thank you for reading.

She said: “In the four years that I’ve sat on this committee, I have never seen members of Congress – Republican or Democrat – disrespect a witness in the way that I have seen them disrespect you today. I do not care what party they are in, I’ve never seen anything like that [...] There’s more than one way to get a point across. Frankly, men who treat women like that in public, I fear how they treat them in private. We can be better than this.” This is not the first time that Alexandria has spoken up to hold those in power accountable for their actions – and it won’t be the last. Here’s why: When incidents of violence or disrespect go unaddressed at the highest levels of government, it conveys that everyday actions of elected leaders in the United States of America don’t matter. But they do matter. This behavior betrays the meaning and importance of the work that happens in the people’s Capitol. And it trickles down to the rest of the country. When this behavior goes unchecked, it says that treating colleagues or other professionals this way at your workplace is acceptable – when it is not. From fighting to censure Representative Paul Gosar after he tweeted an animated video depicting him killing Alexandria and attacking the President, to holding Representative Ted Yoho accountable for calling Alexandria “a f— b—” on the steps of the Capitol – Alexandria will never shy away from holding her colleagues accountable and demanding a high standard of respect and integrity. We hope Alexandria inspires you today to keep demanding the respect you and your colleagues deserve. Thank you for reading. subject: LAST CALL: Can you PLEASE add a donation before MIDNIGHT?
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
Thank you for pitching in right before the finish line.
#

Friends —
We’ve sent a number of emails before tonight’s fundraising deadline. We hope you’ll take it not as an annoyance, but as a sign of how important this really is.
We’re running out of time to reach our goals. That’s a big deal. Because we can’t afford to miss a single one now that we’re in the final sprint to Election Day.
That means doing all we can between today and Election Day for Mark and this campaign — and that starts with our mid-month deadline at midnight.
If we do well, it’ll show Trump and Masters that we have the support to run another strong race. If we come up short, it'll be a sign to them to double down on the millions of dollars they’ve already spent to beat us.
So, please. This is the last chance. If you’ve been waiting for the right time to make your first donation, it’s right now...before midnight.
**Please use this link to contribute $3 or anything you can afford to Mark Kelly’s re-election campaign. Do it before midnight. Do it for Mark.**
[**https://act.markkelly.com/go/Midnight-Deadline**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-sept22.nZ-xom&refcode=em220915-3-7&t=1&akid=3844%2E6688874%2EIwNi-x)
Thank you for pitching in right before the finish line.
Emma Brown
Campaign Manager
Mark Kelly for Senate

Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate

Let's work together to flip Texas blue! | | | [](https://blueactiondems.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ffb3688ddbd9a3513a01d03f0&id=a3b5237b4b&e=e2c3d5ef2f)
---
,I’m back home in Texas, and I couldn’t be more excited.We all know it is a tragedy that we have a government in Texas that is anti-women, anti-LGBT, anti-safety for school children and anti-democracy. I decided I could not stay on the sidelines any longer.**Six weeks ago, Texas Blue Action offered me the opportunity to come home and fight again. I left my position in the Biden administration to come back to Texas and, together with Blue Action, start the most ambitious organizing project I’ve ever been part of:**[**2 Million Texans, a statewide relational Get Out The Vote program.**](https://blueactiondems.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ffb3688ddbd9a3513a01d03f0&id=adccdcbe9a&e=e2c3d5ef2f) This campaign is a direct result of the work we did in 2018 and 2020 (thank you for all your support!) and the work many of us did in Georgia in 2021 to flip the US Senate. _I’m very proud 2MT encompasses my life’s work and the values we all share:_ re-establishing the sense of connection, relationships and community that our society so desperately lacks, and doing that in a way brings the change in government we need.The way the program works is that we all download an app that tells us who among our phone contacts hasn’t yet voted. If each of us can find just 6 people in our phone who didn’t vote in 2018 (I found 98 people in my phone who didn’t vote), and get them to vote this time, we flip the entire state of Texas blue. That’s it! So simple, right? But, we need a LOT of people to do this.Just one month in, we’ve already recruited an unprecedented 1,500 volunteers, and we now have a network of almost 75,000 of their friends that they can remind to vote right from their smartphone. (This is more than Georgia had 5 DAYS before the runoff election). But we have to get tens of thousands more to do the same thing. We’re committed to building the largest relational network in history and reminding 2 million Texans to vote so we can FLIP THIS STATE.We’re funding this 100% through individual contributions. Supporters like you, who powered my two previous Congressional runs are key to making this effort possible.**I**[**’m re-committing to organizing, not just in our district, but statewide across ALL of Texas because it comes down to this: we must reclaim this state. I hope you can make a donation of any amount to help power this effort and grow our program.**](https://blueactiondems.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ffb3688ddbd9a3513a01d03f0&id=260e7f6582&e=e2c3d5ef2f)

body:
National Republicans know that the momentum is on our side

| I'm fired up, Peter.

body:
KeithPekau.com

https://www.keithpekau.com/
Peter,

Last week, I shared with you the statement I read about the state of Illinois’ dangerous SAFE-T Act during a Village of Orland Park board meeting.

I know many of you shared the statement on your social media accounts and via email to let your friends and family in Illinois know what is coming on January 1.

I want to thank you. Because so many helped to spread the word about the SAFE-T Act, the video went viral and was picked up by numerous national news outlets, including FNC’s Tucker Carlson Tonight, America’s Newsroom, Daily Caller, The Post Millennial, Hannity (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EbNfJRYRJeg) , The Greg Gutfeld Show (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9_u-phi_Qzc) , The Charlie Kirk Show (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NSrzt9dO8Fo) , PJ Media...I am told we even went viral on Tic Tok, and high school students are now talking about the SAFE-T Act.

A few of the clips are below, but I wanted to be sure to thank you for taking the time to help spread the word about our campaign to restore common-sense leadership to Congress.

Additionally, this week we released our first campaign ad of the General Election. Titled ‘Service Over Self,’ the ad features 6th District residents, including local military veterans and independent business owners. The piece highlights my record of service to his country and to my community.
https://youtu.be/9p5UBaRmTAE
Click here to watch the ad. (https://youtu.be/9p5UBaRmTAE)

And if you are able, please donate to make sure we can get our message out over the lies Sean Casten and the Democrats are going to tell about me and my record. Any amount, from $15 to $1,500, helps! (https://secure.winred.com/pekau/donate)

Again, thank you for all of your support. We are winning! Let’s keep the momentum going through November!

Thank you,

Keith Pekau
Mayor of Orland Park
Republican Nominee for Illinois’ Sixth Congressional District

In Case You Missed It

Fox News Channel: Tucker Carlson Calls out Illinois’ Insane SAFE-T Act, Plays Viral Video of Pekau Statement
In a segment about the rise in violent crime across the nation, FNC host Tucker Carlson slammed Illinois’ SAFE-T Act. The segment featured the now-viral video (https://www.facebook.com/PekauForCongress/videos/1028293844513204) of Orland Park Mayor Keith Pekau describing the outrageous law.
https://morninganswerchicago.com/2022/09/06/keith-pekau-talks-about-the-race-in-the-6th-congressional-district/?fbclid=IwAR1CSbysEf1jlSVf1nHzTizLS3zJOTETbWwkJ5Uazhyt5RPsB2KhtQ5VQ_0

Commenting on the SAFE-T Act, Carlson stated, “How does this work, exactly? Is this such a Low-T country that no one is going to do anything about this?

“Politicians in Illinois just legalized violent crime against you, and no one’s done anything about it. A lot of these people are going to be re-elected in November... really? How does that work? Where is the constituency for violent crime in this country? Is there anyone who’s for it... other than Kamala Harris, Ron Klain and the ideologues who run this administration? Most people are not for it. Even most Democrats are not for it.

“The SAFE-T Act of Illinois stands for “Safety, Accountability, Fairness and Equity, Today.” So, the reason they’re doing this is that they didn’t like the demographic breakdown of people who were getting arrested for crimes... It was ideologically inconvenient for them, so the solution is to just legalize murder, and kidnapping, and trespassing.”

Watch the segment here. (https://video.foxnews.com/v/6312281575112?fbclid=IwAR0cjQ3scofa_9-v-2XrlaQR0UHowPQF9JPHH5ilVuIAVyoFunQ16rU83kE#sp=show-clips)

Read our press release here. (https://keithpekau.com/pekau-shared-on-tucker-carlson/)
Help bring common-sense leadership to Washington HERE! (https://secure.winred.com/pekau/donate)

Fox News Channel: America’s Newsroom
Mayor Keith Pekau joined Fox News Channel’s America’s Newsroom with Dana Perino and Bill Hemmer to discuss the likely impact of the SAFE-T Act, and the failed governance of JB Pritzker and Lori Lightfoot.
https://video.foxnews.com/v/6312261757112#sp=show-clips

Watch the full interview here. (https://video.foxnews.com/v/6312261757112#sp=show-clips)

+++

Key points:
Perino: “The Governor [of Illinois] is a very left-wing Democrat. Is he listening to any of you?
Pekau: He is not listening to us on this, and historically he doesn’t really listen to any of us. He does whatever he feels like. He did the same thing through COVID: didn’t listen to us. It’s not a surprise that he’s not listening. It’s also not a surprise that they [the Illinois legislature] passed this back in January of last year, and waited until January of 2023 to put it into effect. It’s because they knew the impact that this was going to have and they didn’t want to be running for election after voters saw the impact of such a horrible law.

Hemmer: Why do those who support this law want it in Illinois?
Pekau: I have no idea why someone would want this. It clearly puts citizens and police officers at risk in favor of criminals who are violent. It puts us all at risk. It gets worse than being released without bail. When this goes into effect in January of 2023, a police officer will not be allowed to remove someone from your property for trespassing. They can take residence in your shed, your pool, in a business, and all police can do is ticket someone. By law, they’re not going to be allowed to touch someone to remove them from those premises. Think about how dangerous that will be with people forced to take the law into their own hands.

On Lori Lightfoot shipping Texas migrants to the suburbs:
Pekau: Lori Lightfoot presides over a Sanctuary city, and when migrants are sent there, she immediately ships them to a suburb. If they are sent to our suburb, the first thing we have to do is make sure that those migrants are housed humanely. We’re not going to put them back on a bus like cattle. That’s just inappropriate. To treat people like that - regardless of their circumstances - is just plain wrong. We have to take care of those people, make sure they’re safe first. Then think about keeping our communities safe. And the fact is the migrants, as we know, are not properly vetted... and we turn around and we have a law that doesn’t allow people to be kept behind bars ... what in the world could possibly go wrong with all of those factors being put together?

clean_body: KeithPekau.com Peter, Last week, I shared with you the statement I read about the state of Illinois’ dangerous SAFE-T Act during a Village of Orland Park board meeting. I know many of you shared the statement on your social media accounts and via email to let your friends and family in Illinois know what is coming on January 1. I want to thank you. Because so many helped to spread the word about the SAFE-T Act, the video went viral and was picked up by numerous national news outlets, including FNC’s Tucker Carlson Tonight, America’s Newsroom, Daily Caller, The Post Millennial, Hannity () , The Greg Gutfeld Show () , The Charlie Kirk Show () , PJ Media...I am told we even went viral on Tic Tok, and high school students are now talking about the SAFE-T Act. A few of the clips are below, but I wanted to be sure to thank you for taking the time to help spread the word about our campaign to restore common-sense leadership to Congress. Additionally, this week we released our first campaign ad of the General Election. Titled ‘Service Over Self,’ the ad features 6th District residents, including local military veterans and independent business owners. The piece highlights my record of service to his country and to my community. Click here to watch the ad. () And if you are able, please donate to make sure we can get our message out over the lies Sean Casten and the Democrats are going to tell about me and my record. Any amount, from $15 to $1,500, helps! () Again, thank you for all of your support. We are winning! Let’s keep the momentum going through November! Thank you, Keith Pekau Mayor of Orland Park Republican Nominee for Illinois’ Sixth Congressional District In Case You Missed It Fox News Channel: Tucker Carlson Calls out Illinois’ Insane SAFE-T Act, Plays Viral Video of Pekau Statement In a segment about the rise in violent crime across the nation, FNC host Tucker Carlson slammed Illinois’ SAFE-T Act. The segment featured the now-viral video () of Orland Park Mayor Keith Pekau describing the outrageous law. Commenting on the SAFE-T Act, Carlson stated, “How does this work, exactly? Is this such a Low-T country that no one is going to do anything about this? “Politicians in Illinois just legalized violent crime against you, and no one’s done anything about it. A lot of these people are going to be re-elected in November... really? How does that work? Where is the constituency for violent crime in this country? Is there anyone who’s for it... other than Kamala Harris, Ron Klain and the ideologues who run this administration? Most people are not for it. Even most Democrats are not for it. “The SAFE-T Act of Illinois stands for “Safety, Accountability, Fairness and Equity, Today.” So, the reason they’re doing this is that they didn’t like the demographic breakdown of people who were getting arrested for crimes... It was ideologically inconvenient for them, so the solution is to just legalize murder, and kidnapping, and trespassing.” Watch the segment here. () Read our press release here. () Help bring common-sense leadership to Washington HERE! () Fox News Channel: America’s Newsroom Mayor Keith Pekau joined Fox News Channel’s America’s Newsroom with Dana Perino and Bill Hemmer to discuss the likely impact of the SAFE-T Act, and the failed governance of JB Pritzker and Lori Lightfoot. Watch the full interview here. () +++ Key points: Perino: “The Governor [of Illinois] is a very left-wing Democrat. Is he listening to any of you? Pekau: He is not listening to us on this, and historically he doesn’t really listen to any of us. He does whatever he feels like. He did the same thing through COVID: didn’t listen to us. It’s not a surprise that he’s not listening. It’s also not a surprise that they [the Illinois legislature] passed this back in January of last year, and waited until January of 2023 to put it into effect. It’s because they knew the impact that this was going to have and they didn’t want to be running for election after voters saw the impact of such a horrible law. Hemmer: Why do those who support this law want it in Illinois? Pekau: I have no idea why someone would want this. It clearly puts citizens and police officers at risk in favor of criminals who are violent. It puts us all at risk. It gets worse than being released without bail. When this goes into effect in January of 2023, a police officer will not be allowed to remove someone from your property for trespassing. They can take residence in your shed, your pool, in a business, and all police can do is ticket someone. By law, they’re not going to be allowed to touch someone to remove them from those premises. Think about how dangerous that will be with people forced to take the law into their own hands. On Lori Lightfoot shipping Texas migrants to the suburbs: Pekau: Lori Lightfoot presides over a Sanctuary city, and when migrants are sent there, she immediately ships them to a suburb. If they are sent to our suburb, the first thing we have to do is make sure that those migrants are housed humanely. We’re not going to put them back on a bus like cattle. That’s just inappropriate. To treat people like that - regardless of their circumstances - is just plain wrong. We have to take care of those people, make sure they’re safe first. Then think about keeping our communities safe. And the fact is the migrants, as we know, are not properly vetted... and we turn around and we have a law that doesn’t allow people to be kept behind bars ... what in the world could possibly go wrong with all of those factors being put together? In the past four weeks President Biden has:

| [](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=be6ad5ea16814c01b5d9ea106874e9cb&_e=TEo_kKI3XAMqN6HWCk6KaMu70hDJ9rt-LeP5dH0FN7oosuAPExLWTQb05pq6GzQYpNjjAcoATr8Iobd1adbwKTO_Q8lMz_ychSYNAoL5hWroGGKlnLJkhRbFFyCtW8UCwEWcHCyGtT0qWdSdyQoYoSAbtNt9Q13d-gCBWKULGnumhtbiW_m4yIRsGQGzkGxWXyFLiOUKvsYJ0WG4P2HmIzq8salfu3YquuAIAxPNDrNqnaADSTDMTjUXeGOQnEaCAgiwWNFKF9UesdNbXV2Jb7IbgpBGGMpZxRL-f0CWzQWxoMPZqx5_uIO0oIUvpRfM)
