If you listened to President Biden’s bizarre speech earlier this month, you heard a message meant to scare and divide the public. Like you, we watched the speech wondering: **What ever happened to the “uniter” that Biden tried to portray himself as in the 2020 campaign?**

**The answer is simple:** the “uniter” never existed. By labeling everyday Americans as “extremists," he and the hard left showed their true colors.

Biden doesn’t understand what Make America Great Again (**MAGA**) means to folks like you and me. To us, it stands for timeless principles like limited government, more freedom, personal responsibility, and a strong and secure country.

Biden and Pelosi view Americans who share these conservative beliefs as “**deplorable** ”. They want to destroy each of President Trump’s accomplishments, and in just 2 years, their policies have taken us...

* from a safe, secure border to no border at all
* from safe neighborhoods to record crime
* from stable, affordable prices to record inflation, and
* from energy independence to the highest gas prices in memory

Unfortunately for the American public, the goal for Democrats has never been to govern. **Their goal has been and always will be to tear conservatism apart.** With nothing to show for two years of absolute power in Washington, they’re attempting to make the midterms a referendum on President Trump. _**Why do you think the FBI raided Mar-a-Lago 90 days before the election?**_

Dear Peter, My name is Courtney Geels and I want to represent you in Congress. You and I have something in common...**_we care about your kids and grandkids. _** I'm a nurse, not a politician, and I am truly concerned about what's happening in our schools.**_ _** Our kids deserve a chance at life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness in the years to come. That future is in jeopardy.

School boards focus on COVID lockdowns, gender-fluid propaganda, and critical race theory. Kids are being taught that “you're either a **_racist _**or you're a **_victim_**...based on your skin color.” Just this past spring, a first grader came home from Cameron Park Elementary (now River Park) and told their [adopted white] parents that they were glad they had not been born white because white people are causing damage to the world. THAT is not equity. THAT is not okay. And that is just one small story representing many more just like it.

The left truly believes that** _ government, not parents,_** know what is best for our kids and grandkids!

This is why I need your support.** **

I need volunteers and contributions (large and small) to reach voters just like you--voters who might not realize what is happening right under their noses within the public institutions we've been raised to trust.

**One day my husband and I will have our first baby.** I want my children and my grandchildren to have a bright future and I refuse to co-parent with the government. Will you help me?

For truth, justice, and unity,
Courtney Geels

**Today's Headlines:**

[Op-Ed: Latinas are a voting force that must be engaged](https://vote.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e84c756a73b2b9193783ffd1&id=a271dd4112&e=5bd167f239)
Helen Torres, CEO, Hispanas Organized for Political Equality (HOPE) highlights in her op-ed the influence Latinas have in driving positive change in the country and why they are a key voting block that must be engaged.

[New UT/Texas Politics Project Poll: Abbott maintains 45%-40% lead over O’Rourke; 52% support busing migrants out of Texas | The Texas Politics Project](https://vote.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e84c756a73b2b9193783ffd1&id=bb2f8ad380&e=5bd167f239)
A recently released poll shows Gov. Greg Abbott narrowly leading Democratic challenger Beto O’Rourke, 45%-40%.

[Latino Voters, Once Solidly Democratic, Split Along Economic Lines | The Wall Street Journal](https://vote.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e84c756a73b2b9193783ffd1&id=eb36b79c80&e=5bd167f239)
More Latinos, specifically in the working class, are shifting towards voting for GOP candidates.

[Along the Texas-Mexico border, GOP enthusiasm mounts as Democrats defect over immigration concerns | The Texas Tribune](https://vote.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e84c756a73b2b9193783ffd1&id=7311973138&e=5bd167f239)
Many Democrat voters neat the southern border are flipping Republican due to immigration and border security concerns.

[Arizona Latino voters are up for grabs new poll shows | The Arizona Republic](https://vote.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e84c756a73b2b9193783ffd1&id=56b02b299f&e=5bd167f239)
42% of Latino voters in Arizona say they have been ignored. Time to turn up voter outreach.

[Todos Con Demings: Val Demings seeks support from FL Hispanic voters; will her message resonate? | Florida Phoenix](https://vote.us9.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e84c756a73b2b9193783ffd1&id=756959247e&e=5bd167f239)
U.S. Rep. Val Demings aims to reach out to Latino voters to unseat opponent Marco Rubio.

Fellow Conservative,

Do you know _why_ I decided to become a doctor?

It’s because I knew that many people across the world and within our great country **desperately needed help**. I truly believe that God called on me to assist others during their times of hardship because he knew that I could carry the burdens of those I deliver aid to, improving their lives tremendously.

As a result, the past 35 years of my life have been spent in the medical field.

I graduated magna cum laude from Davidson College in 1985 and then graduated with honors from the UNC School of Medicine. I completed a surgical residency in Urology and Renal Transplantation at the University of Kentucky in Lexington and then opened up my own practice in Greenville, North Carolina, after moving there with my wife over 20 years ago.

I’ve traveled far and wide to places such as India, several parts of Africa, Nicaragua and Haiti as a Medical Missionary, serving both God and people from all walks of life. During this time, I was fortunate enough to meet Mother Teresa, who further inspired me to serve those in need.

My endeavors to lend a helping hand did not stop there. When Congressman Walter B. Jones, Jr. passed away in 2019 after 22 years of service and North Carolina was left without someone to represent their needs, **I felt called on to step up**.

For the past three years, I have been blessed to be able to serve the great people of North Carolina in Congress. Although this journey is a new one, I have learned it is not so different from working in the medical field. _**People want someone to care about their needs and take action to fix the issues that are causing them pain.**_

I excel as a congressman because I know how to take people’s problems into account, and work with individuals toward finding a solution that will result in them feeling great and living prosperously.

It has been a privilege to represent the wonderful people of North Carolina, _but I’m not ready to give up on this position just yet_. I wish to proceed with my duties and continue work on issues that are important to you.

In order for me to fulfill my earthly responsibility and keep North Carolina on course for prosperity, I must implore you to do something for me. name: Cliff Schecter, Blue Amp Action
subject: Kari Lake’s “use of the Court to further a disinformation campaign and false narrative concerning the integrity of the election process in Arizona by asserting demonstrably false allegations is repugnant.”
body:
Will the crank lawsuits ever stop?
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, had you heard about this ridiculous, crank court case attacking our elections? Kari Lake, the Arizona GOP candidate for governor, is now [appealing](https://default.salsalabs.org/T92d95017-1da1-45e4-902c-f8b8509d1acb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) a thrown-out lawsuit against Maricopa County election officials, mostly Republicans themselves. name: Cheri Beasley

body:
I wanted to send you a note before our fundraising drive ends tonight.

Hi there - I wanted to send you a note before our fundraising drive ends tonight.
We’re running a new kind of campaign for North Carolina, because we have to try something new if we’re going to win in just 8 short weeks. We need to organize and reach out to folks in all 100 counties — nobody will be counted out or forgotten. That is what you should expect from your Senator.
But a campaign at this scale requires a significant amount of grassroots support. So if you can use this link to give, it’d mean a lot to me:
[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-sep22?refcode=220915-3**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-sep22.KSPoKB&refcode=em220915-3-MA&t=1&akid=1747%2E357359%2EcnftST)
People are already casting the very first vote by mail ballots here, and in-person early voting starts soon.
One of the most important things I’ve learned running (and winning) statewide before, is that the sooner we can invest in our organizing and outreach operations, the more of an impact we can have. It allows us to plan ahead and make key strategic investments in our ground game — in rural and urban communities alike, from the Blue Ridge Mountains to the Outer Banks.
So every dollar we raise now will pay even greater dividends when the votes are counted. That’ll matter in North Carolina, where polls are showing a statistical tie.
But we’re still short of the goal we set for tonight, the halfway point to the FEC deadline. So I’m personally asking you to contribute before our midnight deadline. Here’s that link again:
[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-sep22?refcode=220915-3**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-sep22.KSPoKB&refcode=em220915-3-MA&t=2&akid=1747%2E357359%2EcnftST)
With your support, this is going to be a campaign that reaches and inspires voters all across North Carolina. Together, we will bring new leadership and a voice for the people to the Senate.
Thanks for helping us leave it all on the field!
\- Cheri

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

If you'd like to unsubscribe | | This isn't good, Peter... Far-right politicians Rick Scott and Chuck Grassley are parachuting into Florida TONIGHT to rally their megadonors around Marco Rubio and flipping the Senate. They're pulling out all the stops to defeat me because they KNOW this race will decide Senate control – and the fact that we have TIED with Rubio in the polls has them TERRIFIED. And the worst part is the GOP's plan could work. With polls showing Marco Rubio and me in a dead heat, this huge fundraising event could give him the extra cash he needs to surge ahead, win this close race and hand Senate control right back to Mitch McConnell. We cannot let that nightmare become a reality. We cannot lose our Senate majority. That's why I'm asking you for a $25 contribution before the GOP rally tonight, Peter. Team,
Today, we wanted to write to you about the 2024 election. We know, we know – we haven’t even made it through 2022 yet. But before you click away, just hear us out.
First, flashback to 2020. Even after it was clear that President Biden had secured the nomination, false claims of election fraud were rampant. These weren’t just conspiracies peddled by fringe groups. In fact, a group of Michigan lawmakers (including Elissa’s opponent) flew to Washington, D.C. to meet with President Trump before the results were certified. And, days before the January 6th insurrection, 10 other members of the Michigan State Senate (again, including Elissa’s opponent) signed a letter asking Congress to investigate claims of election fraud.
Thankfully, the 2020 results were certified by brave government officials across the country, both Democrats and Republicans, who upheld our democratic principles and refused to bend to pressure from those peddling conspiracy and division.
Which leads us to 2022, where many of the states that decided the outcome of 2020 will now have election-deniers on their ballots this November. And once again, Michigan is front and center.
Here in Michigan, the Governor, Attorney General, and Secretary of State are all up for re-election this year – three positions that will be heavily involved in the certification of Michigan’s 2024 election results. All three positions are currently held by Democrats – Gretchen Whitmer, Dana Nessel, and Jocelyn Benson – who have opponents with some alarming views when it comes to the 2020 election.
All members of the U.S. House from Michigan are also up for re-election. We lost a seat in the House when Michigan’s district lines were redrawn last year. So, we are now going from an even 14 seats (divided evenly among Democrats and Republicans) to an odd 13 – where one party will have official control of the Michigan delegation.
Why is this important? Because in 2024, if the electoral college results are inconclusive (like if electors are deadlocked, or there's a tie) – the decision is moved to the House of Representatives. The congressional delegations from each state will then vote as a block to decide which candidate will receive their state's electoral votes. So, it's important that those delegations have a majority that is committed to upholding the results of our democracy.
Ultimately, what we do now – in Michigan and across the country – will determine who certifies the next presidential election. It will determine if we have principled leaders who are willing to uphold America’s democracy. Leaders like Elissa, who is running in the most competitive House race in Michigan, and against a man who has entertained the falsehoods that have turned up the temperature in American politics. So please, consider chipping in today to help reelect someone who will protect our election integrity in 2022, 2024, and beyond.
